alarka iti dharmajñaḥ khyātiṃ loke prayāsyati / kanīyāneṣa te putro matimāṃśca bhaviṣyati
tacchrutvā nāma putrasya kṛtaṃ mātrā mahīpatiḥ / alarka ityasambaddhaṃ prahasyedamathābravīt
rājovāca bhavatyā yadidaṃ nāma matputrasya kṛtaṃ śubhe / kimīdṛśamasambaddhamarthaḥ ko 'sya madālase
madālasovāca kalpaneyaṃ mahārāja ! kṛtā sā vyāvahāriko / tvatkṛtānāṃ tathā nāmnāṃ śṛṇu bhūpa ! nirarthatām
vadanti puruṣāḥ prājñā vyāpinaṃ puruṣaṃ yataḥ / krāntiśca gatiruddiṣṭā deśāddeśāntarantu yā
sarvago na prayātīti vyāpī deheśvaro yataḥ / tato vikrāntasaṃjñeyaṃ matā mama nirarthikā
subāhuriti yā saṃjñā kṛtānyasya sutasya te / nirarthā sāpyamūrtatvāt puruṣasya mahīpate
putrasya yad kṛtaṃ nāma tṛtīyasyārimardanaḥ / manye tadapyasambaddhaṃ śṛṇu cāpyatra kāraṇam
eka eva śarīreṣu sarveṣu puruṣo yadā / tadāsya rājan ! ka śatruḥ ko vā mitramiheṣyate
bhūtairbhūtāni mṛdyante amūrto mṛdyate katham / krodhādīnāṃ pṛthagbhāvāt kalpaneyaṃ nirarthikā
yadi saṃvyavahārārthamasannāma prakalpyate / nāmni kasmādalarkākhye nairarthyaṃ bhavato matam
jaḍa uvāca evamuktastayā sādhu mahīṣyā sa mahīpatiḥ / tathetyāha mahābuddhirdayitāṃ tathyavādinīm
tañcāpi sā sutaṃ subhrūryathā pūrvasutāṃstathā / provāca bodhajananaṃ tāmuvāca sa pārthivaḥ
karoṣi kimidaṃ mūḍhe ! mamābhāvāya santateḥ / duṣṭāvabodhadānena yathāpūrvaṃ suteṣu me
yadi te matpriyaṃ kāryaṃ yadi grāhyaṃ vaco mama / tadenaṃ tanayaṃ mārge pravṛtteḥ sanniyojaya
karmamārgaḥ samucchedaṃ naivaṃ devi ! gamiṣyati / pitṛpiṇḍanivṛttiśca naivaṃ sādhvi ! bhaviṣyati
pitaro devalokasthāstathā tiryaktvamāgatāḥ / tadvanmanuṣyatāṃ yātā bhūtavarge ca saṃsthitāḥ
sapuṇyānasapuṇyāṃśca kṣutkṣāmān tṛṭpariplutān / piṇḍodakapradānena naraḥ karmaṇyavasthitaḥ
sadāpyāyate subhru ! tadvaddevātithonapi / devairmanuṣyaiḥ pitṛbhiḥ pretairbhūtaiḥ saguhyakaiḥ
vayobhiḥ kṛmikīṭaiśca nara evopajīvyate / tasmāt tanvaḍgi ! putraṃ yatkāryaṃ kṣatrayonibhiḥ
aihikāmuṣmikaphalaṃ tat samyak pratipādaya
jaḍa uvāca tenaivamuktā sā bhartrā varanārī madālasā / alarkaṃ nāma tanayamuvācollāpavādinī
putra vardhasva madbharturmano nandaya karmabhiḥ / mitrāṇāmupakārāya durhṛdāṃ nāśanāya ca
dhanyo 'si re yo vasudhāmaśatrur ekaściraṃ pālayitāsi putra / tatpālanādastu sukhopabhogo dharmāt phalaṃ prāpsyasi cāmaratvam
dharāmarān parvasu tarpayethāḥ samīhitaṃ bandhuṣu pūrayethāḥ / hitaṃ parasmai hṛdi cintayethāḥ manaḥ parastrīṣu nivartayethāḥ
yajñauranekairvibudhānajastram arthairdvijān prīṇaya saṃśritāṃśca / striyaśca kāmairatulaiścirāya yuddhaiścārīṃstoṣayitāsi vīra
bālo mano nandaya bāndhavānāṃ gurostathājñānakaraṇaiḥ kumāraḥ / strīṇāṃ yuvā satkulabhūṣaṇānāṃ vṛddho vane vatsa ! vanecarāṇām
rājyaṃ kurvan suhṛdo nandayethāḥ sādhūn rakṣaṃstāta ! yajñairyajethāḥ / duṣṭānnighran vairiṇaścājimadhye goviprārthe vatsa ! mṛtyuṃ vrajethāḥ
iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe putrānuśāsanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ jaḍa uvāca evamullāpyamānastu sa tu mātrā dine dine / vavṛdhe vayasā bālo buddhyā cālarkasaṃjñitaḥ
sa kaumārakamāsādya ṛtadhvajasutastataḥ / kṛtopanayanaḥ prājñaḥ praṇipatyāha mātaram
mayā yadatra kartavyamaihikāmuṣmikāya vai / sukhāya vada tat sarvaṃ praśrayāvanatasya me
madālasovāca vatsa ! rājye 'bhiṣiktena prajārañjanamāditaḥ / kartavyamavirodhena svadharmasya mahībhṛtā
vyasanāni parityajya sapta mūlaharāṇi vai / ātmā ripubhyaḥ saṃrakṣyo bahirmantravinirgamāt
aṣṭadhā nāśamāpnoti sucakrāt syandanādyathā / tathā rājāpyasandigdhaṃ bahirmantravinirgamāt
duṣṭāduṣṭāṃśca jānīyādamātyānaridoṣataḥ / caraiścarāstathā śatroranveṣṭavyāḥ prayatnataḥ
viśvāso na tu kartavyo rājñā mitrāptabandhuṣu / kāryayogādamitre 'pi viśvasīta narādhipaḥ
sthānavṛddhikṣayajñena ṣāḍguṇyaguṇitātmānā / bhavitavyaṃ narendreṇa na kāmavaśavartinā
prāgātmā mantriṇaścaiva tato bhṛtyā mahībhṛtā / jeyāścānantaraṃ paurā virudhyeta tato 'ribhiḥ
yastvetānavijityaiva vairiṇo vijigīṣate / so 'jitātmā jitāmātyaḥ śatruvargeṇa bādhyate
tasmāt kāmādayaḥ pūrvaṃ jeyāḥ putra ! mahībhujā / tajjaye hi jayo 'vaśyaṃ rājā naśyati tairjitaḥ
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca mado mānastathaiva ca / harṣaśca śatravo hyete vināśāya mahībhṛtām
kāmaprasaktamātmānaṃ smṛtvā pāṇḍuṃ nipātitam / nivartayettathā krodhādanuhrādaṃ hatātmajam
hatamailaṃ tathā lobhānmadādvenaṃ dvijairhatam / mānādanāyuṣāputraṃ baliṃ harṣāt purañjayam
ebhirjitairjitaṃ sarvaṃ maruttena mahātmanā / smṛtvā vivarjayedetān doṣān svīyānmahīpatiḥ
kākakokilabhṛṅgāṇāṃ mṛgavyālaśikhaṇḍinām / haṃsakukkuṭalohānāṃ śikṣeta carita nṛpaḥ
kīṭakasya kriyāṃ kuryāt vipakṣe manujeśvaraḥ / ceṣṭāṃ pipīlikānāñca kāle bhūpaḥ pradarśayet
jñeyāgnivisphuliṅgānāṃ bījaceṣṭā ca śālmaleḥ / candrasūryasvarūpeṇa nītyarthe pṛthivīkṣitā
bandhakīpadmaśarabhaśūlikāgurviṇīstanāt / prajñā nṛpeṇa cādeyā tathā gopālayoṣitaḥ
śakrārkayamasomānāṃ tadvadvāyormahīpatiḥ / rūpāṇi pañca kurvota mahīpālanakarmaṇi
yathendraścaturo māsān toyotsargeṇa bhūgatam / āpyāyayettathā lokaṃ parihārairmahīpatiḥ
māsānaṣṭau yathā sūryastoyaṃ harati raśmibhiḥ / sūkṣmeṇaivābhyupāyena tathā śulkādikaṃ nṛpaḥ
yathā yamaḥ priyadveṣye prāptakāle niyacchati / tathā priyāpriye rājā duṣṭāduṣṭe samo bhavet
pūrṇendumālokya yathā prītimān jāyate naraḥ / evaṃ yatra prajāḥ sarvā nirvattāstacchaśivratam
mārutaḥ sarvabhūteṣu nigūḍhaścarate yathā / evaṃ nṛpaścareccāraiḥ paurāmātyādibandhuṣu
na lobhādvā na kāmādvā nārthādvā yasya mānasam / yathānyaiḥ kṛṣyate vatsa ! sa rājā svargamṛcchati
utpathagrāhiṇo mūḍhān svadharmāccalato narān / yaḥ karoti nije dharme sa rājā svargamṛcchati
varṇadharmā na sīdanti yasya rājye tathāśramāḥ / vatsa ! tasya sukhaṃ pretya paratreha ca śāśvatam
etadrājñaḥ paraṃ kṛtyaṃ tathaitat siddhikārakam / svadharmasthāpanaṃ nṛṇāṃ cālyante ye kubuddhibhiḥ
pālanenaiva bhūtānāṃ kṛtakṛtyo mahīpatiḥ / samyak pālayitā bhāgaṃ dharmasyāpnoti yatnataḥ

iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe pitāputrasaṃvāde ātmaviveko nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ aṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ jaḍa uvāca tanmāturvacanaṃ śrutvā so 'larko mātaraṃ punaḥ / papraccha varṇadharmāṃśca dharmā ye cāśrameṣu ca
alarka uvāca kathito 'yaṃ mahābhāge ! rājyatantrāśritastvayā / dharmaṃ tamahamicchāmi śrotuṃ varṇāśramātmakam
madālasovāca dānamadhyayanaṃ yajño brāhmaṇasya tridhā mataḥ / nānyaścaturtho dharmo 'sti dharmastasyāpadaṃ vinā
yājanādhyāpane śuddhe tathā pūtapratigrahaḥ / eṣā samyak samākhyatā trividhā cāsya jīvikā
dānamadhyayanaṃ yajñaḥ kṣatriyasyāpyayaṃ tridhā / dharmaḥ proktaḥ kṣite rakṣā śastrājīvañca jīvikā
dānamadhyayanaṃ yajño vaiśyasyāpi tridhaiva saḥ / vāṇijyaṃ pāśupālyañca kṛṣiścaivāsya jīvikā
dānaṃ yajño 'tha śuśrūṣā dvijātīnāṃ tridhā mayā / vyākhyātaḥ śūdradharmo 'pi jīvikā kārukarma ca
tadvad dvijātiśuśrūṣā poṣaṇaṃ krayavikrayau / varṇadharmāstvime proktāḥ śrūyantāṃ cāśramāśrayāḥ
svavarṇadharmāt saṃsiddhiṃ naraḥ prāpnoti na cyutaḥ / prayāti narakaṃ pretya pratiṣiddhaniṣevaṇāt
yāvattu nopanayanaṃ kriyate vai dvijanmanaḥ / kāmaceṣṭoktibhakṣyaśca tāvad bhavati putraka
kṛtopanayanaḥ samyag brahmacārī gururgṛhe / vasettatra ca dharmo 'sya kathyate taṃ nibodha me
svādhyāyo 'thāgriśuśrūṣā snānaṃ bhikṣāṭanaṃ tathā / gurornivedya taccānnamanujñātena sarvadā
guroḥ karmaṇi sodyogaḥ samyak prītyupapādanam / tenāhūtaḥ paṭheccaiva tatparo nānyamānasaḥ
ekaṃ dvau sakalān vāpi vedān prāpya gurormukhāt / anujñāto 'tha vanditvā dakṣiṇāṃ gurave tataḥ
gārhasthyāśramakāmastu gṛhasthāśramamāvaset / vānaprasthāśramaṃ vāpi caturthaṃ cecchayātmanaḥ
tatraiva vā gurorgehe dvijo niṣṭhāmavāpnuyāt / gurorabhāve tatputre tacchiṣye tatsutaṃ vinā
śuśrūṣurnirabhimāno brahmacāryāśramaṃ vaset / upāvṛttastatastasmāt gṛhasthāśramakāmyayā
tato 'samānarṣikulāṃ tulyāṃ bhāryāmarogiṇīm / udvahennyāyato 'vyaṅgāṃ gṛhasthāśramakāraṇāt
svakarmaṇā dhanaṃ labdhvā pitṛdevātithīṃstathā / samyak samprīṇayan bhaktyā poṣayeccāśritāṃstathā
bhṛtyātmajān jāmayo 'tha dīnāndhapatitānapi / yathāśaktyānnadānena vayāṃsi paśavastathā
eṣa dharmo gṛhasthasya ṛtāvabhigamastathā / pañcayajñavidhānantu yathāśaktyā na hāpayet
pitṛdevātithijñātibhuktaśeṣaṃ svayaṃ naraḥ / bhuñjīta ca samaṃ bhṛtyairyathāvibhavamādṛtaḥ
eṣa tūddeśataḥ prokto gṛhasthasyāśramo mayā / vānaprasthasya dharmaṃ te kathayāmyavadhāryatām
apatyasantatiṃ dṛṣṭvā prājño cānatim / vānaprasthāśramaṃ gacchedātmanaḥ śuddhikāraṇāt
tatrāraṇyopabhogaśca tapobhiścānukarṣaṇam / bhūmau śayyā brahmacaryaṃ pitṛdevātithikriyā
homastriṣavaṇastrānaṃ jaṭāvalkaladhāraṇam / yogābhyāsaḥ sadā caiva vanyasnehaniṣevaṇam
ityeṣa pāpaśuddhyarthamātmanaścopakārakaḥ / vānaprasthāśramastasmād bhikṣostu caramo 'paraḥ
caturthasya svarūpaṃ tu śruyatāmāśramasya me / yaḥ svadharmo 'sya dharmajñaiḥ proktastāta ! mahātmabhiḥ
sarvasaṅgaparityāgo brahmacaryamakopitā / yatendriyatvamāvāse naikasmin vasatiściram
anārambhastathāhāro bhaikṣānnenaikakālinā / ātmajñānāvabodhecchā tathā cātmāvalokanam
caturthe tvāśrame dharmo mayāyaṃ te niveditaḥ / sāmānyamanyavarṇānāmāśramāṇāñca me śṛṇu
satyaṃ śaucamahiṃsā ca anasūyā tathā kṣamā / ānṛśaṃsyamakārpaṇyaṃ santoṣaścāṣṭamo guṇaḥ
ete saṃkṣepataḥ proktā dharmā varṇāśrameṣu te / eteṣu ca svadharmeṣu sveṣu tiṣṭhet samantataḥ
yaścollaṅghya svakaṃ dharmaṃ svavarṇāśramasaṃjñitam / naro 'nyathā pravarteta sa daṇḍyo bhūbhṛto bhavet
ye ca svadharmasantyāgāt pāpaṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ / upekṣatastān nṛpateriṣṭāpūrtaṃ praṇaśyati
tasmādrājñā prayatnena sarve varṇāḥ svadharmataḥ / pravartanto 'nyathā daṇḍyāḥ sthāpyāścaiva svakarmasu

iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe putrānuśāsane madālasāvākyaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ #1 ūnatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ alarka uvāca yat kāryaṃ puruṣāṇāñca gārhasthyamanuvartatām / bandhaśca syādakaraṇe kriyāyā yasya cocchritiḥ
upakārāya yannṛṇāṃ yacca varjyaṃ gṛhe satā / yathā ca kriyate tanme yathāvat pṛcchato vada
madālasovāca vatsa ! gārhasthyamādāya naraḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat / puṣṇāti tena lokāṃśca sa jayatyabhivāñchitān
pitaro munayo devā bhūtāni manujāstathā / kṛmikīṭapataṅgāśca vayāṃsi paśavo 'surāḥ
gṛhasthamupajīvanti tatastṛptiṃ prayānti ca / mukhaṃ cāsya nirīkṣante api no dāsyatīti vai
sarvasyādhārabhūteyaṃ vatsa ! dhenustrayīmayī / yasyāṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ viśvaṃ viśvahetuśca yā matā
ṛkpṛṣṭhāsau yajurmadhyā sāmavaktraśirodharā / iṣṭāpūrtaviṣāṇā ca sādhusūktatanūruhā
śāntipuṣṭiśakṛnmūtrā varṇapādapratiṣṭhitā / ājīvyamānā jagatāṃ sākṣayā nāpacīyate
svāhākārasvadhākārau vaṣaṭkāraśca putraka ! / hantakārastathā cānyastasyāḥstanacatuṣṭayam
svāhākāraṃ stanaṃ devāḥ pitaraśca svadhāmayam / munayaśca vaṣaṭkāraṃ devabhūtasuretarāḥ
hantakāraṃ manuṣyāśca pibanti satataṃ stanam / evamāpyāyayatyeṣā vatsa ! dhenustrayīmayī
teṣāmucchedakartā ca yo naro 'tyantapāpakṛt / sa tamasyāndhatāmistre tāmistre ca nimajjati
yaścemāṃ mānavo dhenuṃ svairvatsairamarādibhiḥ / pāyayatyucite kāle sa svargāyopapadyate
tasmāt putra ! manuṣyeṇa devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ / bhūtāni cānudivasaṃ poṣyāṇi svatanuryathā
tasmāt strātaḥ śucirbhūtvā devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam / prajāpatestathaivādibhaḥ kāle kuryāt samāhitaḥ
sumanogandhapuṣpaiśca devānabhyarcya mānavaḥ / tato 'gnestarpaṇaṃ kuryāddeyāśca balayastathā
brahmaṇe gṛhamadhye tu viśvedevebhya eva ca / dhanvantariṃ samuddiśya prāgudīcyāṃ baliṃ kṣipet
prācyāṃ śakrāya yāmyāyāṃ yamāya balimāharet / pratīcyāṃ varuṇāyātha somāyottarato balim
dadyāddhātre vidhātre baliṃ dvāre gṛhasya tu / aryamṇe 'tha bahirdadyād gṛhebhyaśca samantataḥ
naktañcarebhyo bhūtebhyo balimākāśato haret / pitṝṇāṃ nirvapeccaiva dakṣiṇābhimukhasthitaḥ
gṛhasthastatparo bhūtvā susamāhitamānasaḥ / tatastoyamupādāya teṣvevācamanāya vai
sthāneṣu nikṣipet prājñastāstā uddiśya devatāḥ / evaṃ gṛhabaliṃ kṛtvā gṛhe hṛhapatiḥ śuciḥ
āpyāyanāya bhūtānāṃ kuryādutsargamādarāt / śvabhyaśca śvapacebhyaśca vayobhyaścāvaped bhuvi
vaiśvadevaṃ hi nāmaitat sāyaṃ prātarudāhṛtam / ācamya ca tataḥ kuryāt prājño dvārāvalokanam
muhūrtasyāṣṭamaṃ bhāgamudīkṣyo 'pyatithirbhavet / atithiṃ tatra samprāptamannādyenodakena ca
sampūjayedyathāśakti gandhapuṣpādibhistathā / na mitramatithiṃ kuryānnaikagrāmanivāsinam
ajñātakulanāmānaṃ tatkālasamupasthitam / bubhukṣumāgataṃ śrāntaṃ yācamānamakiñcanam
brāhmaṇaṃ prāhuratithiṃ sa pūjyaḥ śaktito budhaiḥ / na pṛcched gotracaraṇaṃ svādhyāyañcāpi paṇḍitaḥ
śobhanāśobhanākāraṃ taṃ manyeta prajāpatim / anityaṃ hi sthito yasmāt tasmādatithirucyate
tasmiṃstṛpte nṛyajñotthādṛṇānmucyed gṛhāśramī / tasmād adattvā yo bhuṅkte svayaṃ kilviṣabhuṅnaraḥ
sa pāpaṃ kevalaṃ bhuṅkte purīṣañcānyajanmani / atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhāt pratinivartate
sa dattvā duṣkṛtaṃ tasmai puṇyamādāya gacchati / apyambuśākadānena yadvāpyaśnāti sa svayam
pūjayet tu naraḥ śaktyā tenaivātithimādarāt / kuryāccāharahaḥ śrāddhamannādyenodakena ca
pitṝnuddiśya viprāṃśca bhojayedviprameva vā / annasyāgraṃ taduddhṛtya brāhmaṇāyopapādayet
bhikṣāñca yācatāṃ dadyāt parivrāḍbrahmacāriṇām / grāsapramāṇā bhikṣā syādagraṃ grāsacatuṣṭayam
agraṃ caturguṇaṃ prāhurhantakāraṃ dvijottamāḥ / bhojanaṃ hantakāraṃ vā agraṃ bhikṣāmathāpi vā
adattvā tu na bhoktavyaṃ yathāvibhavamātmanaḥ / pūjayitvātithīniṣṭān jñātīn bandhūṃstathārthinaḥ
vikalān bālavṛddhāṃśca bhojayeccāturāṃstathā / vāñchate kṣutparītātmā yaccānyo 'nnamakiñcanaḥ
kuṭumbinā bhojanīyaḥ samarthe vibhave sati / śrīmantaṃ jñātimāsādya yo jñātiravasīdati
sīdatā yad kṛtaṃ tena tat pāpaṃ sa samaśnute / sāyaṃ caiva vidhiḥ kāryaḥ sūryoḍhaṃ tatra cātithim
pūjayīta yathāśakti śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ / evamuddavahatastāta ! gārhasthyaṃ bhāramāhitam
skandhe vidhātā devāśca pitaraśca maharṣayaḥ / śreyo 'bhivarṣiṇaḥ sarve tathaivātithibāndhavāḥ
paśupakṣigaṇāstṛptā ye cānye sūkṣmakīṭakāḥ / gāthāścātra mahābhāga ! svayamatriragāyata
tā śṛṇuṣva mahābhāga ! gṛhasthāśramasaṃsthitāḥ / devān pitṝṃścātithīṃśca tadvat sampūjya bāndhavān
jāmayaśca guruñcaiva gṛhastho vibhave sati / śvabhyaśca śvapacebhyaśca vayobhyaścāvaped bhuvi
vaiśvadevaṃ hi nāmaitat kuryāt sāyaṃ tathā dine / māṃsamannaṃ tathā śākaṃ gṛhe yaccopasādhitam / na ca tat svayamaśnīyādvidhivadyanna nirvapet
iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe madālasopadeśo nāmonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ madālasovāca nityaṃ naimittakañcaiva nityanaimittikaṃ tathā / gṛhasthasya tu yat karma tanniśāmaya putraka !
pañcayajñāśritaṃ nityaṃ yadetat kathitaṃ tava / naimittikaṃ tathaivānyat putrajanmakriyādikam
nityanaimittikaṃ jñeyaṃ parvaśrāddhādi paṇḍitaiḥ / tatra naimittikaṃ vakṣye śrāddhamabhyudayaṃ tava
putrajanmani yatkāryaṃ jātakarmasamaṃ naraiḥ / vivāhādau ca kartavyaṃ sarvaṃ samyak krimoditam
pitaraścātra sampūjyāḥ khyātā nāndīmukhāstu ye / piṇḍāṃśca dadhisaṃmiśrān dadyād yavasamanvitān
udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ / vaiśvadevavihīnaṃ tat kecidicchanti mānavāḥ
yugmāścātra dvijāḥ kāryāste ca pūjyāḥ pradakṣiṇam / etannaimittikaṃ vṛddhau tathānyaccaurdhvadehikam
mṛtāhani ca kartavyamekoddiṣṭaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat / daivahīnaṃ tathā kāryaṃ tathaivaikapavitrakam
āvāhanaṃ na kartavyamagnaukaraṇavarjitam / pretasya piṇḍamekañca dadyāducchiṣṭasannidhau
tilodakaṃ cāpasavyaṃ tannāmasmaraṇānvitam / akṣayyamamukasyeti sthāne vipravisarjane
abhiraṇyatāmiti brūyād brūyuste 'bhiratāḥ sma ha / pratimāsaṃ bhavedetat kāryamā vatsaraṃ naraiḥ
atha saṃvatsare pūrṇe yadā vā kriyate naraiḥ / sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ tasyāpi vidhirucyate
taccāpi daivarahitamekārghyaikapavitrakam / naivāgnaukaraṇaṃ tatra taccāvāhanavarjitam
apasavyañca tatrāpi bhojayedayujo dvijān / viśeṣastatra cānyo 'sti pratimāsaṃ kriyādhikaḥ
taṃ kathyamānamekāgro vadantyā me niśāmaya / tilagandhodakairyuktaṃ tatra pātracatuṣṭayam
kuryāt pitṝṇāṃ tritayamekaṃ pretasya putraka / pātratraye pretapātramarghyañcaiva prasecayet
ye samānā iti japan pūrvavaccheṣamācaret / strīṇāmapyevamevaitadekīddiṣṭamudāhṛtam
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ tāsāṃ putrābhāve na vidyate / pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kāryamekoddiṣṭaṃ naraiḥ striyāḥ
mṛtāhani yathānyāyaṃ nṛṇāṃ yadvadihoditam / putrābhāve sapiṇḍāstu tadabhāve sahodakāḥ
mātuḥ sapiṇḍā ye ca syurye ca mātuḥ sahodakāḥ / kuryurenaṃ vidhiṃ samyagaputrasya sutāsutaḥ
kuryurmātāmahāyaivaṃ putrikāstanayāstathā / dvyāmuṣyāyaṇasaṃjñāstu mātāmahapitāmahān
pūjayeyuryathānyāyaṃ śrāddhairnaimittikairapi / sarvābhāve striyaḥ kuryuḥ svabhartṝṇāmamantrakam
tadabhāve ca nṛpatiḥ kārayet svakuṭumbinā / tajjātīyairnaraiḥ samyāg dāhādyāḥ sakalāḥ kriyāḥ
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ bāndhavo nṛpatiryataḥ / etāste kathitā vatsa ! nityanaimittakāstathā
kriyāṃ śrāddhāśrayāmanyāṃ nityanaimittikīṃ śṛṇu / darśastatra nimittaṃ vai kālaścandrakṣayātmakaḥ / nityātāṃ niyataḥ kālastasyāḥ saṃsūcayatyatha

iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe alarkānuśāsane naimittikādiśrāddhakalpo nāma triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ekatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ madālasovāca sapiṇḍīkaraṇādūrdhvaṃ pituryaḥ prapitāmahaḥ / sa tu lepabhujo yāti praluptaḥ pitṛpiṇḍataḥ
teṣāmanyaścaturtho yaḥ putralepabhujānnabhuk / so 'pi sambandhato hīnamupabhogaṃ prapadyate
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ / piṇḍasambandhino hyete vijñeyāḥ puruṣāstrayaḥ
tepasambandhinaścānye pitāmahapitāmahāt / prabhṛtyuktāstrayasteṣāṃ yajamānaśca saptamaḥ
ityeṣa mu nabhiḥ proktaḥ sambandhaḥ sāptapauruṣaḥ / yajamānāt prabhṛtyūrdhvamanulepabhujastathā
tato 'nye pūrvajāḥ sarve ye cānye narakaukasaḥ / ye ca tiryaktvamāpannā ye ca bhūtādisaṃsthitāḥ
tān sarvān yajamāno vai śrāddhaṃ kurvan yathāvidhi / samāpyāyayate vatsa ! yena yena śṛṇuṣva tat
annaprakiraṇaṃ yat tu manuṣyaiḥ kriyate bhuvi / tena tṛtpimupāyānti ye piśācatvamāgatāḥ
yadambu strānavastrotthaṃ bhūmau patati putraka ! / tena ye tarutāṃ prāptāsteṣāṃ tṛptiḥ prajāyate
yāstu gātrāmbukaṇikāḥ patanti dharaṇītale / tābhirāpyāyanaṃ teṣāṃ ye devatvaṃ kule gatāḥ
uddhṛteṣvatha piṇḍeṣu yāścānnakaṇikā bhuvi / tābhirāpyāyanaṃ prāptā ye tiryakatvaṃ kule gatāḥ
ye vādagdhāḥ kule bālāḥ kriyāyogyā hyasaṃskṛtāḥ / vipannāste 'nnavikira-saṃmārjanajalāśinaḥ
bhuktvā cācāmatāṃ yacca jalaṃ yaccāṅghrisecane / brāhmaṇānāṃ tathaivānye tena tṛptiṃ prayānti vai
evaṃ yo yajamānasya yaśca teṣāṃ dvijanmanām / kaścijjalānnavikṣepaḥ śucirucchiṣṭa eva vā
tenānye tatkule tatra tattadyonyantaraṃ gatāḥ / prayāntyāpyāyanaṃ vatsa ! samyak śrāddhakriyāvatām
anyāyopārjitairarthairyacchrāddhaṃ kriyate naraiḥ / tṛpyante tena cāṇḍālapukkasādyāsu yoniṣu
evamāpyāyanaṃ vatsa ! bahūnāmiha bāndhavaiḥ / śrāddhaṃ kurvadibharannāmbubindukṣepeṇa jāyate
tasmācchrāddhaṃ naro bhaktyā śākairapi yathāvidhi / kurvota kurvataḥ śrāddhaṃ kule kaścinna sīdati
tasya kālānahaṃ vakṣye nityanaimittikātmakān / vidhinā yena ca naraiḥ kriyate tannibodha me
kāryaṃ śrāddhamamāvāsyāṃ māsi māsyuḍupakṣaye / tathāṣṭakāsvapyavaśyamicchākālaṃ nibodha me
viśiṣṭabrāhmaṇaprāptau sūryendugrahaṇe 'yane / viṣuve ravisaṃkrāntau vyatipāte ca putraka
śrāddhārhadravyasamprāptau tathā duḥsvapnadarśane / janmarkṣagrahapīḍāsu śrāddhaṃ kurvota cecchayā
viśiṣṭaḥ śrotriyo yogī vedavijjyeṣṭhasāmagaḥ / triṇāciketastrimadhustrisuparṇaḥ ṣaḍaṅgavit
dauhitraṛtvigjāmātṛsvastrīyāḥ śvaśurastathā / pañcāgnikarmaniṣṭhaśca taponiṣṭho 'tha mātulaḥ
mātāpitṛparāścaiva śiṣyasambandhibāndhavāḥ / ete dvijottamāḥ śrāddhe samastāḥ ketanakṣamāḥ
avakīrṇo tathā rogī nyūne cāṅge tathādhike / paunarbhavastathā kāṇaḥ kuṇḍo golo 'tha putraka
mitradhruk kunakhī klībaḥ śyāvadanto nirākṛtiḥ / abiśastastu tātena piśunaḥ somavikrayī
kanyādūṣayitā vaidyo gurupitrostathojjhakaḥ / bhṛtakādhyāpako 'mitraḥ parapūrvāpatistathā
vedojjho 'thāgnisantyāgī vṛṣalīpatidūṣitaḥ / tathānye ca vikarmasthā varjyāḥ pitryeṣu vai dvijāḥ
nimantrayeta pūrvedyuḥ pūrvoktān dvijasattamān / daive niyoge pitrye ca tāṃstathaivopakalpayet
taiśca saṃyatibhirbhāvyaṃ yaśca śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati / śrāddhaṃ dattvā ca bhuktvā ca maithunaṃ yo 'nugacchati
pitarastu tayormāsaṃ tasmina retasi śerate / gatvā ca yoṣitaṃ śrāddhe yo bhuṅkte yaśca gacchati
retomūtrakṛtāhārāstanmāsaṃ pitarastayoḥ / tasmāttu prathamaṃ kāryaṃ prājñenopanimantraṇam
aprāptau taddine cāpi varjyā yoṣitprasaṅginaḥ / bhikṣārthamāgatān vāpi kāle saṃyamino yatīn
bhojayet praṇipātādyaiḥ prāsādya yatamānasaḥ / yathaiva śuklapakṣādvai pitṝṇāmasitaḥ priyaḥ
tathāparāhnaḥ pūrvāhnāt pitṝṇāmatirityate / saṃpūjya svāgatenaitānabhyupetān gṛhe dvijān
pavitrapāṇirācāntānāsaneṣūpaveśayet / pitṝṇāmayujaḥ kāmaṃ yugmān daive dvijottamān
ekaikaṃ vā pitṝṇāñca devānāñca svaśaktitaḥ / tathā mātāmahānāñca tulyaṃ vā vaiśvadevikam
pṛthak tayostathā cānye kecidicchanti mānavāḥ / prāṅmukhāndaivasaṅkalpān paitryān kuryādudaṅmukhān
tathaiva mātāmahānāṃ vidhirukto manīṣibhiḥ / viṣṭarārthe kuśān dattvā pūjya cārghyādinā budhaḥ
pavitrakādi vai dattvā tebhyo 'nujñāmavāpya ca / kuryādāvāhanaṃ prājño devānāṃ mantrato dvijaḥ
yavāmbhobhistathā cārghyaṃ dattvā vai vaiśvadevikam / gandhamālyāmbudhūpañca dattvā samyak sadipakam
apasavyaṃ pitṝṇāñca sarvamevopakalpayet / darbhāṃśca dviguṇān dattvā tebhyo 'nujñāmavāpya ca
mantrapūrvaṃ pitṝṇāñca kuryādāvāhanaṃ budhaḥ / apasavyaṃ tathā cārghyaṃ yavārthañca tathā tilaiḥ
niṣpādayenmahābhāga ! pitṝṇaṃ prīṇane rataḥ / agnau kāryamanujñātaḥ kuruṣveti tato dvijaiḥ
juhuyādvyañjanakṣāravarjyamannaṃ yathāvidhi / agnaye kavyavāhāya svaheti prathamāhutiḥ
somāya vai pitṛmate svāhetyanyā tathā bhavet / yamāya pretapataye svāheti tritayāhutiḥ
hutāvaśiṣṭaṃ dadyācca bhājaneṣu dvijanmanām / bhājanālambhanaṃ kṛtvā dadyāccānnaṃ yathāvidhi
yathā sukhaṃ juṣadhvaṃ bho iti vācyamaniṣṭhuram / bhuñjīraṃśca tataste 'pi taccittā mauninaḥ sukham
yadyadiṣṭacatamaṃ teṣāṃ tattadannamasatvaram / akrudhyaṃśca naro dadyāt sambhavena pralobhayan
rakṣoghrāṃśca japenmantrāṃstilaiśca vikirenmahīm / siddhārthakaiśca rakṣārthaṃ śrāddhaṃ hi pracuracchalam
pṛṣṭaistṛptaiśca tṛptāḥ stha tṛptāḥ sma iti vādibhiḥ / anujñāto narastvannaṃ prakiret bhuvi sarvataḥ
tadvadācamanārthāya dadyādāpaḥ sakṛt sakṛt / anujñāñca tataḥ prāpya yatavākkāyamānasaḥ
satilena tato 'nnena piṇḍān savyena putraka ! / pitanuddiśya darbheṣu dadyāducchiṣṭasannidhau
pitṛtīrthena toyañca dadyāttebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ / pitṝniddiśya yadbhaktyā yajamāno nṛpātmaja
tadvanmātāmahānāñca dattvā piṇḍān yathāvidhi / gandhamālyādisaṃyuktaṃ dadyādācamanaṃ tataḥ
dattvā ca takṣiṇāṃ śaktyā susvadhāstviti tān vadet / taiśca tuṣṭaistathetyuktvā vācayedvaiśvadevikān
prīyantāmiti bhadraṃ vo viśvedevā itīrayen / tatheti cokte tairvipraiḥ prārthanīyāstadāśiṣaḥ
visarjayet priyāṇyuktvā praṇipatya ca bhaktitaḥ / ādvāramanugaccheccāgaccheccānupramoditaḥ
tato nityakriyāṃ kuryād bhojayecca tathātithīn / nityakriyāṃ pitṝṇāñca kecidicchanti sattamāḥ
na pitṝṇāntathaivānye śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret / pṛthak pākena netyanye kecit pūrvañca pūrvavat
tatastadannaṃ bhuñjīta saha bhṛtyādibhirnaraḥ / evaṃ kurvota dharmajñaḥ śrāddhaṃ pitryaṃ samāhitaḥ
yathā vā dvijamukhyānāṃ paritoṣo 'bhijāyate / trīṇi śrāddhe pavitrāṇi dauhitraṃ kutapastilāḥ
varjyāni cāhurviprendra ! kopo 'dhvagamanaṃ tvarā / rājatañca tathā pātraṃ śastaṃ śrāddheṣu putraka !
rajatasya tathā kāryaṃ darśanaṃ dānameva vā / rājate hi svadhā dugdhā pitṛbhiḥ śrūyate mahī / tasmāt pitṝṇāṃ rajatamabhīṣṭaṃ prītivardhanam

iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe 'larkānuśāsane pārvaṇaśrāddhakalponāma ekatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ madālasovāca ataḥ paraṃ śṛṇuṣvemaṃ putra ! bhaktyā yadāhṛtam / pitṝṇāṃ prītaye yadvā varjyaṃ vā prītikārakam
māsaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptiśca haviṣyānnena jāyate / māsadvayaṃ matsyamāṃsaistṛptiṃ yānti pitāmahāḥ
trīn māsān hāriṇāṃ māṃsaṃ vijñeyaṃ pitṛtṛptaye / caturmāsāṃstu puṣṇāti śaśasya piśitaṃ pitṝn
śākunaṃ pañca vai māsān ṣaṇmāsān śūkarāmiṣam / chāgalaṃ sapta vai māsānaiṇeyañcāṣṭamāsikīm
karoti tṛptiṃ nava vai rurormāṃsaṃ na saṃśayaḥ / gavayasyāmiṣaṃ tṛptiṃ karoti daśamāsikīm
tathaikādaśamāsaṃstu aurabhraṃ pitṛtṛptidam / saṃvatsaraṃ tathā gavyaṃ payaḥ pāyasameva vā
vādhrīṇasāmiṣaṃ lauhaṃ kālaśākantathā madhu / dauhitrāmiṣamanyacca yaccānyat svakulodbhavaiḥ
anantāṃ vai prayacchanti tṛptiṃ gaurīsutastathā / pitṝṇāṃ nātra sandeho gāyāśrāddhañca putraka
śyāmākarājaśyāmākau tadvaccaiva prasātikāḥ / nīvārāḥ pauṣkalāścaiva dhānyānāṃ pitṛtṛptaye
yavavrīhisagodhūmatilā mudgāḥ sasarṣapāḥ / priyaṅgavaḥ kovidārā niṣpāvāścātiśobhanāḥ
varjyā markaṭakāḥ śrāddhe rājamāṣāstathāṇavaḥ / viprāṣikā masūrāśca śrāddhakarmaṇi garhitāḥ
laśunaṃ gṛñjanañcaiva palāṇḍaṃ,piṇḍamūlakam / karambhaṃ yāni cānyāni hīnāni rasavarṇataḥ
gāndhārikāmalābūni lavaṇānyūṣarāṇi ca / āraktā ye ca niryāsāḥ pratyakṣalavaṇāni ca
varjyānyetāni vai śrāddhe yacca vācā na śasyate / yaccotkocādinā prāptaṃ patitādyadupārjitam
anyāyakanyāśulkotthaṃ dravyañcātra vigarhitam / durgandhi phenilañcāmbu tathaivālpatarodakam
na labhedyatra gaustṛptiṃ naktaṃ yaccāpyupāhṛtam / yanna sarvāpacotsṛṣṭaṃ yaccābhojyaṃ nipānajam
tadvarjyaṃ salilaṃ tāta ! sadaiva pitṛkarmaṇi / mārgamāvikamauṣṭrañca sarvamaikaśaphañca yat
māhiṣañcāmarañcaiva dhenvā goścāpyanirdaśam / pitrarthaṃ me prayacchasvetyuktvā yaccāpyupāhṛtam
varjanīyaṃ sadā sadibhastatpayaḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi / varjyā jantumatī rūkṣā kṣitiḥ pluṣṭā tathāgninā
aniṣṭaduṣṭaśabdogradurgandhā cātra karmaṇi / kulāpamānakāḥ śrāddhe vyāyujya kulahiṃsakāḥ
nagnāḥ pātakinaścaiva hanyurdṛṣṭyā pitṛkriyām / apumānapaviddhaśca kukkuṭo grāmaśūkaraḥ
śvā caiva hanti śrāddhāni yātudhānāśca darśanāt / tasmāt susaṃvṛto dadyāttilaiścāvakiranmahīm
evaṃ rakṣā bhavecchrāddhe kṛtā tātobhayorapi / śāvasūtakasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ dīrgharogibhireva ca
patitairmalinaiścaiva na puṣṇāti pitāmahān / varjanīyaṃ tathā śrāddhe tathodakyāśca darśanam
muṇḍaśauṇḍasamābhyāso yajamānena yādarāt / keśakīṭāvapannañca tathāśvabhiravekṣitam
pūti paryuṣitañcaiva vārtākyabhiṣavāṃstathā / varjanīyāni vai śrāddhe yacca vastrānilāhatam
śraddhayā parayā dattaṃ pitṝṇāṃ nāmagotrataḥ / yadāhārāstu te jātāstadāhāratvameti tat
tasmāt śraddhāvatā pātre yacchastaṃ pitṛkarmaṇi / yathāvaccaiva dātavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimicchatā
yoginaśca sadā śrāddhe bhojanīyā vipaścitā / yogādhārā hi pirarastasmāt tān pūjayet sadā
brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrebhyo yogī tvagrāśanī yadi / yajamānañca bhoktṝṃśca naurivāmbhasi tārayet
pitṛgāthāstathavātra gīyante brahmavādibhiḥ / yā gītāḥ pitṛbhiḥ pūrvamailasyāsīnmahīpateḥ
kadā naḥ santatāvagryaḥ kasyacid bhavitā sutaḥ / yo yogibhuktaśoṣānno bhuvi piṇḍaṃ pradāsyati
gayāyāmathavā piṇḍaṃ khaḍgamāṃsaṃ mahāhaviḥ / kālaśākaṃ tilāḍhyaṃ vā kṛsaraṃ māsatṛptaye
vaiśvadevañca saumyañca khaḍgamāṃsaṃ paraṃ haviḥ / viṣāṇavarjyakhaḍgāptyā āsūryañcāśnuvāmahe
dadyāt śrāddhaṃ trayodaśyāṃ maghāsu ca yathāvidhi / madhusarpiḥ samāyuktaṃ pāyasaṃ dakṣiṇāyane
tasmāt sampūjayet bhaktyā svapitṝn putra mānavaḥ / kāmānabhīpsan sakalān pāpāccātmavimocanam
vasūn rudrāṃstathādityānnakṣatragrahatārakāḥ / prīṇayanti manuṣyāṇāṃ pitaraḥ śrāddhatarpitāḥ
āyuḥ prajñāṃ dhanaṃ vidyāṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ sukhāni ca / prayacchanti tathā rājyaṃ pitaraḥ śrāddhatarpitāḥ
etat te putra ! kathitaṃ śrāddhakarma yathoditam / kāmyānāṃ śrūyatāṃ vatsa ! śrāddhānāṃ tithikīrtanam
iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe śrāddhakalpo nāma dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ trayastriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ madālasovāca pratipaddhanalābhāya dvitīyā dvipadapradā / varārthinī tṛtīyā tu caturtho śatrunāśinī
śriyaṃ prāproti pañcamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pūjyo bhavennaraḥ / gaṇādhipatyaṃ saptamyāmaṣṭamyāṃ vṛddhimuttamām
striyo navamyāṃ prāproti daśamyāṃ pūrṇakāmatām / vedāṃstathāpnuyāt sarvānekādaśyāṃ kriyāparaḥ
dvādaśyāṃ jayalābhañca prāproti pitṛpūjakaḥ / prajāṃ medhāṃ paśuṃ vṛddhiṃ svatantryaṃ puṣṭamuttamām
dīrghamāyurathaiśvaryaṃ kurvāṇastu trayodaśīm / avāproti na sandehaḥ śrāddhaṃ śraddhāparo naraḥ
yathāsambhāvitānnena śrāddhasampatsamanvitaḥ / yuvānaḥ pitaro yasya mṛtāḥ śastreṇa vā hatāḥ
tena kāryaṃ caturdaśyāṃ teṣāṃ prītimabhīpsatā / śrāddhaṃ kurvannamāvāsyāṃ yatnena puruṣaḥ śuciḥ
sarvān kāmānavāproti svargañcānantamaśnute / kuttikāsu pitṝnarcya svargamāproti mānavaḥ
apatyakāmo rohiṇyāṃ saumye caujasvitāṃ labhet / śauryamārdrāsu cāproti kṣetrādi ca punarvasau
puṣṭiṃ puṣye sadābhyarcya āśleṣāsu varān sutān / maghāsu svajanaśraiṣṭhyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ phālgunīṣu ca
pradānaśīlo bhavati sāpatyaścottarāsu ca / prayāti śreṣṭhatāṃ satyaṃ haste śrāddhaprado naraḥ
rūpayuktaśca citrāsu tathāpatyānyavāpnuyāt / vāṇijyalābhadā svātirviśākhā putrakāmadā
kurvantaścānurādhāsu labhante cakrāvartitām / ādhipatyañca jyeṣṭhāsu mūle cārogyamuttamam
āṣāḍhāsu yaśaḥ prāptiruttarāsu viśokatā / śravaṇe ca śubhān lokān dhaniṣṭhāsu dhanaṃ mahat
vedavittvamabhijiti bhiṣaksiddhantu vāruṇe / ajāvikaṃ prauṣṭhapade vinded gāstu tathottare
revatīṣu tathā kupyamaśvinīṣu turaṅgamān / śrāddhaṃ kurvaṃstathāproti bharaṇīṣvāyuruttamam / tasmāt kāmyāni kurvota ṛkṣeṣveteṣu tattvavit

iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe kāmyaśrāddhaphalakathanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ madālasovāca evaṃ putra ! gṛhasthena devatāḥ pitarastathā / saṃpūjyā havyakavyābhyāmannenātithibāndhavāḥ
bhūtāni bhṛtyāḥ sakalāḥ paśupakṣipipīlikāḥ / bhikṣavo yācamānāśca ye cānye vasatā gṛhe
sadācāravatā tāta ! sādhunā gṛhamedhinā / pāpaṃ bhuṅkte samullaṅghya nityanaimittikīḥ kriyāḥ
alarka uvāca kathitaṃ me tvayā mātarnitya naimittikañca yat / nityanaimittikañcaiva trividhaṃ karma pauruṣam
sadācāramahaṃ śrotumicchāmi kulanandini / yat kurvan sukhamāproti paratreha ca mānavaḥ
madālasovāca gṛhasthena sadā kāryamācāraparipālanam / na hyācāravihīnasya sukhamatra paratra vā
yajñadānatapāṃsīha puruṣasya ca bhūtaye / bhavanti yaḥ sadācāraṃ samullaṅghya pravartate
durācāro hi puruṣo nehāyurvindate mahat / kāryo yatnaḥ sadācāre ācāro hantyalakṣaṇam
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi sadācārasya putraka / tanmamaikamanāḥ śrutvā tathaiva paripālaya
trivargasādhane yatnaḥ kartavyo gṛhamedhinā / tatsaṃsiddho gṛhasthasya siddhiratra paratra ca
pādenārthasya pāratryaṃ kuryāt sañcayamātmavān / ardhena cātmabharaṇannityanaimittikānvitam
pādañcātmārthamāyasya mūlabhūtaṃ vivardhayet / evamācarataḥ putra ! arthaḥ sāphalyamarhati
tadvat pāpaniṣedhārthaṃ dharmaḥ kāryo vipaścitā / paratrārthaṃ tathaivānyaḥ kāmyo 'traiva phalapradaḥ
pratyavāyabhayāt kāmyastathānyaścāvirodhavān / dvidhā kāmo 'pi gaditastrivargasyāvirodhataḥ
paramparānubandhāṃśca dharmādīṃstān śṛṇuṣva me
dharmo dharmānubandhārtho dharmo nātmārthabādhakaḥ / ubhābhyāñca dvidhā kāmastena tau ca dvidhā punaḥ
bāhme muhūrte budhyeta dharmārthau cāpi cintayet / samutthāya tathācamya prāṅmukho niyataḥ śuciḥ
pūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ sanakṣatrāṃ paścimāṃ sadivākarām / upāsīta yathānyāyaṃ naināṃ jahyādanāpadi
asatpralāpamanṛtaṃ vākpāruṣyañca varjayet / asacchāstramasadvādamasatsevāñca putraka !
sāyaṃ prāpatastathā homaṃ kurvota niyatātmavān / nodayāstamane bimbamudīkṣeta vivasvataḥ
keśaprasādhanādarśadarśanaṃ dantadhāvanam / pūrvāhna eva kāryāṇi devatānāñca tarpaṇam
grāmāvasathatīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāñcaiva vartmani / viṇmūtraṃ nānutiṣṭheta na kṛṣṭe na ca govraje
nagnāṃ parastriyaṃ nekṣenna paśyedātmanaḥ sakṛt / udakyā darśanāṃ sparśo varjyaṃ sambhāṣaṇantathā
nāpsu mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā maithunaṃ vā samācaret / nādhitiṣṭhecchakṛnmūtrakeśabhasmakapālikāḥ
tuṣāṅgārāsthiśīrṇāni rajjuvastrādikāni ca / nādhitiṣṭhettathā prājñaḥ pathi caivantathā bhuvi
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ bhūtānāñca tathārccanam / kṛtvā vibhavataḥ paścād gṛhastho bhoktumarhati
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi svācānto vāgyataḥ śuciḥ / bhuñjītānnañca taccitto hyantarjānuḥ sadā naraḥ
upagātādṛte doṣaṃ nānyasyodīrayed budhaḥ / pratyakṣalavaṇaṃ varjyamannamatyuṣṇameva ca
na gacchanna ca tiṣṭhan vai viṇmūtrotsargamātmavān / kurvota naiva cācāman yat kiñcidapi bhakṣayet
ucchiṣṭo nālapet kiñcit svādhyāyañca vivarjayet / gāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tathā cāgniṃ svamūrdhānañca na spṛśet
na ca paśyedraviṃ nenduṃ na nakṣatrāṇi kāmataḥ / bhinnāsanaṃ tathā śayyāṃ bhājanañca vivarjayet
gurūṇāmāsanaṃ deyamabhyutthānādisatkṛtam / anukūlaṃ tathālāpamabhivādanapūrvakam
tathānugamanaṃ kuryāt pratikūlaṃ na saṃjayet / naikavastraśca bhuñjīta na kuryāddevatārcanam
na vāhayed dvijānnāgnau mehaṃ kurvot buddhimān / snāyīta na naro nagno na śayīta kadācana
na pāṇibhyāmubhābhyāñca kaṇḍūyeta śirastathā / na cābhīkṣṇaṃ śiraḥ strānaṃ kāryaṃ niṣkāraṇaṃ naraiḥ
śiraḥ strātaśca tailena nāṅgaṃ kiñcidapi spṛśet / anadhyāyeṣu sarveṣu svādhyāyañca vivarjayet
brāhmaṇānilagosūryān na meheta kadācana / udaṅmukho divā rātrāvutsargaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ
ābādhāṣu yathākāmaṃ kuryānmūtrapurīṣayoḥ / duṣkṛtaṃ na gurorbrūyāt kruddhaṃ cainaṃ prasādayet
parivādaṃ na śṛṇuyādanyeṣāmapi kurvatām / panthā deyo brāhmaṇānāṃ rājño duḥ khāturasya ca
vidyādhikasya gurviṇyā bhārārtasya yavīyasaḥ / mūkāndhabadhirāṇāñca mattasyonmattakasya ca
puṃścalyāḥ kṛtavairasya bālasya patitasya ca / devālakaṃ caityataruṃ tathaiva ca catuṣpatham
vidyādhikaṃ guruṃ devaṃ budhaḥ kuryāt pradakṣiṇam / upānadvastramālyādi dhṛtamanyairna dhārayet
upavītamalaṅkāraṃ karakañcaiva varjayet / caturdaśyāntathāṣṭamyāṃ pañcadaśyāñca parvasu
tailābhyaṅgaṃ tathā bhogaṃ yoṣitaśca vivarjayet / na kṣiptapādajaṅghaśca prājñastiṣṭhet kadācana
na cāpi vikṣipet pādau pādaṃ pādena nākramet / marmābhighātamākrośaṃ paiśunyañca vivarjayet
dambhābhimānatīkṣṇāni na kurvota vicakṣaṇaḥ / mūrkhonmattavyasanino virūpānmāyinastathā
nyūnāṅgāṃścādhikāṅgāṃśca nopahāsairvidūṣayet / parasya daṇḍaṃ nodyacchecchikṣārthaṃ putraśiṣyayoḥ
tadvannopaviśet prājñaḥ pādenākramya cāsanam / saṃyāvaṃ kṛṣaraṃ māṃsaṃ nātmārthamupasādhayet
sāyaṃ prātaśca bhoktavyaṃ kṛtvā cātithipūjanam / prāṅmukhodaṅmuko vāpi vāgyato dantadhāvanam
kurvota satataṃ vatsa ! varjayedvarjyavīrudhaḥ / nodakśirāḥ svapejjātu na capratyakśirā naraḥ
śirasyagastyamāsthāya śayītātha purandaram / na tu gandhavatīṣvapsu snāyīta na tathā niśi
uparāge paraṃ snānamṛte dinamudāhṛtam / apamṛjyānna cāsnāto gātrāṇyambarapāṇibhiḥ
na cāpi dhūnayet keśān vāsasī na ca dhūnayet / nānulepanamādadyādasnātaḥ karhicid budhaḥ
na cāpi raktavāsāḥ syāccitrāsitadharo 'pi vā / na ca kuryādviparyāsaṃ vāsasornāpi bhūṣaṇe
varjyañca vidaśaṃ vastramatyantopahatañca yat / keśakīṭāvapannañca kṣuṇṇaṃ śvabhiravekṣitam
avalīḍhāvapannañca sāroddharaṇadūṣitam / pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ vṛthāmāṃsaṃ varjyamāṃsañca putraka !
na bhakṣayīta satataṃ pratyakṣalavaṇāni ca / varjyaṃ ciroṣitaṃ putra ! bhaktaṃ paryuṣitañca yat
piṣṭaśākekṣupayasāṃ vikārānnṛpanandana! / tathā māṃsavikārāṃśca te ca varjyāściroṣitāḥ
udayāstamane bhānoḥ śayanañca vivarjayet / nāsnāto naiva saṃviṣṭo na caivānyamanā naraḥ
na caiva śayane norvyāmupaviṣṭo na śabdavat / na caikavastro na vadan prekṣatāmapradāya ca
bhuñjīta puruṣaḥ snātaḥ sāyaṃ prātaryathāvidhi / paradārā na gantavyāḥ puruṣeṇa vipaścitā
iṣṭāpūrtāyuṣāṃ hantrī paradāragatirnṛṇām / na hīdṛśamanāyuṣyaṃ loke kiñcana vidyate
yādṛśaṃ puruṣasyeha paradārābhimarṣaṇam / devārcanāgnikāryāṇa tathā gurvabhivādanam
kurvota samyagācamya tadvadannabhujikriyām / aphenābhiragandhābhiradbharacchābhirādarāt
ācāmet putra ! puṇyābhiḥ prāṅmukhodaṅmukho 'pi vā / antarjalādāvasathādvalmīkānmūṣikasthalāt
kṛtaśaucāvaśiṣṭāśca varjayet pañca vai mṛdaḥ / prakṣālya hastau pādau ca samabhyukṣya samāhitaḥ
antarjānustathā'cāmet triścaturvā pibedapaḥ / parimṛjya dvirāsyāntaṃ khāni mūrdhānameva ca
samyagācamya toyena kriyāṃ kurvota vai śuciḥ / devatānāmṛṣīṇāñca pitṝṇāñcaiva yatnataḥ
samāhitamanā bhūtvā kurvota satataṃ naraḥ / kṣuttvā niṣṭhīvya vāsaśca paridhāyācamed budhaḥ
kṣute 'valīḍhe vānte ca tathā niṣṭhīvanādiṣu / kuryādācamanaṃ sparśaṃ gopṛṣṭhasyārkadarśanam
kurvotālambanaṃ cāpi dakṣiṇaśravaṇasya vai / yathāvibhavato hyetat pūrvābhāve tataḥ param
avidyamāne pūrvokte uttaraprāptiriṣyate / na kuryād dantasaṅgharṣaṃ nātmano dehatāḍanam
svapnādhyayanabhojyāni sandhyayośca vivarjayet / sandhyāyāṃ maithunañcāpi tathā prasthānameva ca
pūrvāhne tāta ! devānāṃ manuṣyāṇāñca madhyame / bhaktyā tathāparāhne ca kurvota pitṛpūjanam
śiraḥ snātaśca kurvota daivaṃ paitryamathāpi vā / prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi śmaśrukarma ca kārayet
vyaṅginīṃ varjayet kanyāṃ kulajāmapi rogiṇīm / vikṛtāṃ piṅgalāñcaiva vācāṭāṃ sarvadūṣitām
avyaṅgīṃ saumyanāsāñca sravalakṣaṇalakṣitām / tādṛśīmudvahet kanyāṃ śreyaḥ kāmo naraḥ sadā
udvahet pitṛmātrośca saptamīṃ pañcamīntathā / rakṣeddārān tyajedīrṣyāṃ divā ca svapnamaithune
paropatāpakaṃ karma jantupīḍāñca varjayet / udakyā sarvavarṇānāṃ varjyā rātricatuṣṭayam
strījanmaparihārārthaṃ pañcamīmapi varjayet / tataḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vrajedrātryāṃ śreṣṭhā yugamāsu putraka
yugmāsu putrā jāyante striyo 'yugmāsu rātriṣu / tasmādyugmāsu putrārtho saṃviśeta sadā naraḥ
vidharmiṇo 'hni pūrvākhye sandhyākāle ca ṣaṇḍakāḥ / kṣurakarmaṇi vānte ca strīsambhoge ca putraka
snāyīta celavān prājñaḥ kaṭabhūmimupetya ca / devavedadvijātīnāṃ sādhusatyamahātmanām
guroḥ pativratānāñca tayā yajvitapasvinām / parivādaṃ na kurvota parihāsañca putraka
kurvatāmavinītānāṃ na śrotavyaṃ kathañcana / notkṛṣṭaśayyāsanayornāpakṛṣṭasya cāruhet
na cāmaṅgalyaveśaḥ syānna cāmaṅgalyavāgbhavet / dhavalāmbharasaṃvītaḥ sitapuṣpavibhūṣitaḥ
noddhūtonmattamūḍhaiśca nāvinītaiśca paṇḍitaḥ / gacchenmaitrīṃ na cāśīlairna ca cauryādidūṣitaiḥ
na cātivyayaśīlaiśca na lubdhairnāpi vairibhiḥ / na bandhakībhirna nyūnairbandhakīpatibhistathā
sārdhaṃ na balibhiḥ kuryānna ca nyūnairna ninditaiḥ / na sarvaśaṅkibhirnityaṃ na ca daivaparairnaraiḥ
kurvota sādhubhirmaitrīṃ sadācārāvalambibhiḥ / prājñairapiśunaiḥ śaktaiḥ karmaṇyudyogabhāgibhiḥ
suhṛddīkṣitabhūpālasnātakaśvaśuraiḥ saha / ṛtvigādīn ṣaḍarghārhānarcayecca gṛhāgatān
yathāvibhavataḥ putra ! dvijān saṃvatsaroṣitān / arcayenmadhuparkeṇa yathākālamatandritaḥ
tiṣṭhecca śāsane teṣāṃ śreyaskāmo dvijottamaḥ / na ca tān vivadedvīmānākruṣṭaścāpi taiḥ sadā
samyaggṛhārcanaṃ kṛtvā yathāsthānamanukramāt / saṃpūjayettato vahniṃ dadyāccaivāhutīḥ kramāt
prathamāṃ brahmaṇe dadyāt prajānāṃpataye tataḥ / tṛtīyāñcaiva guhyebhyaḥ kaśyapāya tathāparām
tato 'numataye dattvā dadyād gṛhabalintataḥ / pūrvākhyātaṃ mayā yatte nityakarmakriyāvidhau
vaiśvadevantataḥ kuryāddhalayastatra me śṛṇu / yathāsthānavibhāgantu devānuddiśya vai pṛthake
parjanyāya dharitrīṇāṃ dadyācca māṇake trayam / vāyave ca pratidiśaṃ digbhyaḥ prācyāditaḥ kramāt
brahmaṇe cāntarīkṣāya sūryāya ca yathākramama / viśvebhyaścaiva devebhyo viśvabūtabhya eva ca
uṣase bhūtapataye dadyāccottaratastataḥ / svadhā nama itītyuktvā pitṛbhyaścāpi dakṣiṇe
kṛtvāpasavyaṃ vāyavyāṃ yakṣmaitatteti bhājanāt / annāvaśeṣamicchan vai toyaṃ dadyādyathāvidhi
tato 'nnāgraṃ samuddhṛtya hantakāropakalpanam / yathāvidhi yathānyāyaṃ brāhmaṇāyopapādayet
kuryāt karmāṇi tīrthena svena svena yathāvidhi / devādīnāntathā kuryād brāhmeṇācamanakriyām
aṅguṣṭhottarato rekhā pāṇeryā dakṣiṇasya tu / etad brāhmamiti khyātaṃ tīrthamācamanāya vai
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayorantaḥ paitryaṃ tīrthamudāhṛtam / pitṝṇāṃ tena toyādi dadyānnāndīmukhādṛte
aṅgulyagre tathā daivaṃ tena divyakriyāvidhiḥ / tīrtha kaniṣṭhikāmūle kāyaṃ tena prajāpateḥ
evamebhiḥ sadā tīrthairdevānāṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha / sadā kāryāṇi kurvota nānyatīrthena karhicit
brāhmeṇācamanaṃ śastaṃ pitryaṃ paitryeṇa sarvadā / devatīrthena devānāṃ prājāpatyaṃ nijena ca
nāndīmukhānāṃ kurvota prājñaḥ piṇḍodakakriyām / prājāpatyena tīrthena yacca kiñcit prajāpateḥ
yugapajjalamagniñca bibhṛyānna vicakṣaṇaḥ / gurudevān prati tathā na ca pādau prasārayet
nācakṣīta dhayantīṃ gāṃ jalaṃ nāñjalinā pibet / śaucakāleṣu sarveṣu guruṣvalpeṣu vā punaḥ
na vilambeta śaucārthaṃ na mukhenānalaṃ dhamet / tatra putra ! na vastavyaṃ yatra nāsti catuṣṭayam
ṛṇapradātā vaidyaśca śrotriyaḥ sajalā nadī / jitāmitro nṛpo yatra balavān dharmatatparaḥ
tatra nityaṃ vaset prājñaḥ kutaḥ kunṛpatau sukham / yatrāpradhṛṣyo nṛpatiryatra śasyavatī mahī
paurāḥ susaṃyatā yatra satataṃ nyāyavartinaḥ / yatrāmatsariṇo lokāstatra vāsaḥ sukhodayaḥ
yasmin kṛṣībalā rāṣṭre prāyaśo nātibhoginaḥ / yatrauṣadhanyaśeṣāṇi vasettatra vicakṣaṇaḥ
tatra putra na ! vastavyaṃ yatraitat tritayaṃ sadā / jigīṣuḥ pūrvavairaśca janaśca satatotsavaḥ
vasennityaṃ suśīleṣu sahavāsiṣu paṇḍitaḥ / ityetat kathitaṃ putra ! mayā te hitakāmyayā

iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe alarkānuśāsane sadācārakathanaṃ nāma catustriṃ śo 'dhyāyaḥ pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ madālasovāca ataḥ paraṃ śṛṇuṣva tvaṃ varjyāvarjyapratikriyām / bhojyamannaṃ paryuṣitaṃ snehāktaṃ cirasaṃbhṛtam
asnehāścāpi godhūmayavagorasavikriyāḥ / śaśakaḥ kacchapo godhā śvāvit khaḍgo 'tha putraka
bhakṣyā hyete tathā varjyau grāmaśūkarakukkuṭau / pitṛdevādiśeṣaśca śrāddhe brāhmaṇakāmyayā
prokṣitañcauṣadhārthañca khādanmāṃsaṃ na duṣyati / śaṅkhāśmasvarṇarūpyāṇāṃ rajjūnāmatha vāsasām
śākamūlaphalānāñca tathā vidalacarmaṇām / maṇivajrapravālānāntathā muktāphalasya ca
gātrāṇāñca manuṣyāṇāmambunā śaucamiṣyate / yathāyasānāṃ toyena grāvṇaḥ saṅgharṣaṇena ca
sastrehānāñca bhāṇḍānāṃ śuddhiruṣṇena vāriṇā / śūrpadhānyājinānāñca muṣalolūkhalasya ca
saṃhatānāñca vastrāṇāṃ prokṣaṇāt sañcayasya ca / valkalānāmaśeṣāṇāmambumṛcchaucamiṣyate
tṛṇakāṣṭhauṣadhīnāñca prokṣaṇāt śuddhiriṣyate / āvikānāṃ samastānāṃ keśānāñcāpi medhyatā
siddhārthakānāṃ kalkena tilakalkena vā punaḥ / sāmbunā tāta ! bhavati upaghātavatāṃ sadā
tathā kārpāsikānāñca viśuddhirjalabhasmanā / dārudantāsthiśṛṅgāṇāṃ takṣaṇācchuddhiriṣyate
punaḥ pākena bhāṇḍānāṃ pārthivānāñca medhyatā / śucirbhaikṣaṃ kāruhastaḥ paṇyaṃ yoṣinmukhaṃ tathā
rathyāgatamavijñātaṃ dāsavargādināhṛtam / vākrapraśāstaṃ cirātītamanekāntaritaṃ laghu
atiprabhūtaṃ bālañca vṛddhāturaviceṣṭitam / karmāntāṅgārāśālāśca stanandhayasutāḥ striyaḥ
śucinyaśca tathaivāpaḥ strantyo 'gandhabudbudāḥ / bhūmirviśudhyate kālāddāhamārjanagokramaiḥ
lepādullekhanāt sekādveśmasaṃmārjanārcanāt / keśakīṭāvapanne ca goghrāte makṣikānvite
mṛdambubhasmanā tāta ! prokṣitavyaṃ viśuddhaye / audumbarāṇāmamlena kṣāreṇa trapusīsayoḥ
bhasmāmbubhiśca kāṃsyānāṃ śuddhiḥ plāvād dravasya ca / amedhyāktasya mṛttoyairgandhāpaharaṇena ca
anyeṣāñcaiva taddravyairvarṇagandhāpahārataḥ / śuci gotṛptikṛttoyaṃ prakṛtisthaṃ mahīgatam
tathā māṃsañca caṇḍālakrāvyādādinipātitam / rathyāgatañca celādi tāta ! vātāt śuci smṛtam
rajo 'gniraśvo gauśchāyā raśmayaḥ pavano mahī / vipruṣo makṣikādyāśca duṣṭasaṅgādadoṣiṇaḥ
ajāśvau mukhato medhyau na gorvatsasya cānanam / mātuḥ prastravaṇaṃ medhyaṃ śakuniḥ phalapātane
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ nāvaḥ pathi tṛṇāni ca / somasūryāṃśupavanaiḥ śudhyante tāni paṇyavat
rathyāvasarpaṇa-strāna-kṣutpāna-mlānakarmasu / ācāmeta yathānyāyaṃ vāso viparidhāya ca
spṛṣṭānāmapyasaṃsargairvirathyākardamāmbhasām / pakveṣṭaracitānāñca medhyatā vāyusaṅgamāt
prabhūtopahatādannādagramuddhṛtya santyajet / śeṣasya prokṣaṇaṃ kuryādācamyādibhastathā mṛdā
upavāsastrirātrantu duṣṭabhaktāśino bhavet / ajñāte jñānapūrvantu taddoṣopaśamena tu
udakyāśvaśṛgālādīn sūtikāntyāvasāyinaḥ / spṛṣṭvā snāyīta śaucārthaṃ tathaiva mṛtahāriṇaḥ
nāraṃ spṛṣṭvāsthi sastrehaṃ strātaḥ śudhyati mānavaḥ / ācamyaiva tu niḥ strehaṃ gāmālabhyārkamīkṣya vā
na laṅghayet tathaivāsṛkṣṭhīvanodvartanāni ca / nodyānādau vikāleṣu prājñastiṣṭhet kadācana
na cālapejjanadviṣṭāṃ vīrahīnāntathā striyam / gṛhāducchiṣṭaviṇmūtrapādāmbhāṃsi kṣipedvahiḥ
pañca piṇḍānanudhṛtya na strāyāt paravāriṇi / strāyīta devakhāteṣu gaṅgā-hradṛsaritsu ca
devatā-pitṛ-sacchāstra-yajña-mantrādinindakaiḥ / kṛtvā tu sparśanālāpaṃ śudhyetārkāvalokanāt
avalokya tathodakyāmantyajaṃ patitaṃ śavam / vidharmi-sūtikā-ṣaṇḍa-vivastrāntyāvasāyinaḥ
sūtaniryātakāṃścaiva paradāraratāśca ye / etadeva hi kartavyaṃ prājñaiḥ śodhanamātmanaḥ
abhojyaṃ sūtikā-ṣaṇḍa-mārjārākhuśvakukkuṭān / patitāviddhacaṇḍāla-mṛtahārāṃśca dharmavit
saṃspṛśya śudhyate strānādudakyā grāmaśūkarau / tadvacca sūtikāśaucadūṣitau puruṣāvapi
yasya cānudinaṃ hānirgṛhe nityasya karmaṇaḥ / yaśca brāhmaṇasantyaktaḥ kilviṣī sa narādhamaḥ
nityasya karmaṇo hāniṃ na kurvota kadācana / tasya tvakaraṇe bandhaḥ kevalaṃ mṛtajanmasu
daśāhaṃ brāhmaṇastiṣṭheddānahomādivarjitaḥ / kṣatriyo dvādaśāhañca vaiśyo māsārdhameva ca
śūdrastu māsamāsīta nijakarmavivarjitaḥ / tataḥ paraṃ nijaṃ karma kuryuḥ sarve yathoditam
protāya salilaṃ deyaṃ bahirdagdhvā tu gotrikaiḥ / prathame 'hni caturthe ca saptame navame tathā
bhasmāsthicayanaṃ kāryaṃ caturthe gotrikairdine / urdhvaṃ saṃcayanāt teṣāmaṅgasparśo vidhīyate
sodakaistu kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kāryāḥ saṃcayanātparam / sparśa eva sapiṇḍānāṃ mṛtāhani tathobhayoḥ
anvekamṛkṣamāśastra-toyodbandhana-vahniṣu / viṣaprapātādimṛte prāyonāśakayorapi
bāle deśāntarasthe ca tathā pravrajite mṛte / sadyaḥ śaucamathānyaiśca tryahamuktamaśaucakam
sapiṇḍānāṃ sapiṇḍastu mṛte 'nyasminmṛto yadi / pūrvāśaucasamākhyātaiḥ kāryāstvatra dinaiḥ kriyāḥ
eṣa eva vidhirdṛṣṭo janmanyapi hi sūtake / sapiṇḍānāṃ sapiṇḍeṣu yathāvatsodakeṣu ca
jāte putre pituḥ strānaṃ sacelantu vidhīyate / tatrāpi yadi cānyasmin jāte jāyeta cāparaḥ
tatrāpi śuddhiruddiṣṭā pūrvajanmavato dinaiḥ / daśadvādaśamāsārdha-māsasaṃkhyairdinairgataiḥ
svāḥ svāḥ karmakriyāḥ kuryuḥ sarve varṇā yathāvidhi / pretamuddiśya kartavyamekoddiṣṭaṃ tataḥ param
dānani caiva deyāni brāhmaṇebhyo manīṣibhiḥ / yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yaccāpi yayitaṃ gṛhe
tattad guṇavate deyaṃ tadevākṣayamicchatā / pūrṇaistu divasaiḥ spṛṣṭvā salilaṃ vāhanāyudham
pratodadaṇḍau ca tathā samyagvarṇāḥ kṛtakriyāḥ / svavarṇadharmanirdiṣṭamupādānaṃ tathā kriyāḥ
kuryuḥ samastāḥ śucinaḥ paratreha ca bhūtidāḥ / adhyetavyā trayī nityaṃ bhavitavyaṃ vipaścitā
dharmato dhanamāhāryaṃ yaṣṭavyañcāpi yatnataḥ / yaccāpi kurvato nātmā jugupsāmeti putraka !
tatkartavyamaśaṅkena yanna gopyaṃ mahājane / evamācarato vatsa ! puruṣasya gṛhe sataḥ / dharmārthakāmasaṃprāptyā paratreha ca śobhanam
iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe 'larkānuśāsane varjyāvarjyanāmā pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ jaḍa uvāca sa evamanuśiṣṭaḥ san mātrā saṃprāpya yauvanam / ṛtadhvajasutaścakre samyagdāraparigraham
putrāṃścotpādayāmāsa yajñaiścāpyayajadvibhuḥ / pituśca sarvakāleṣu cakārājñānupālanam
tataḥ kālena mahatā saṃprāpya caramaṃ vayaḥ / cakre 'bhiṣekaṃ putrasya tasya rajye ṛtadhvajaḥ
bhāryayā saha dharmātmā yiyāsustapase vanam / avatīrṇo mahārakṣo mahābhāgo mahīpatiḥ
madālasā ca tanayaṃ prāhedaṃ paścimaṃ vaca / kāmopabhogasaṃsargaprahāṇāya sutasya vai
madālasovāca yadā duḥ khamasahyaṃ te priyabandhuviyogajam / śatrubādhodbhavaṃ vāpi vittanāśātmasambhavam
bhavettat kurvato rājyaṃ gṛhadharmāvalambinaḥ / duḥ khāyatanabhūto hi mamatvālambano gṛhī
tadāsmāt putra ! niṣkṛṣya maddattādaṅgulīyakāt / vācyaṃ te śāsanaṃ paṭṭe sūkṣmākṣaraniveśitam
jaḍa uvāca ityuktvā pradadau tasmai sauvarṇaṃ sāṅgulīyakam / āśiṣaścāpi yā yogyāḥ paruṣasya gṛhe sataḥ
tataḥ kubalayāśvo 'sau sā ca devī madālasā / putrāya dattvā tadrājyaṃ tapase kānanaṃ gatau
saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ jaḍa uvāca so 'pyalarko yathānyāyaṃ putravanmuditāḥ prajāḥ / pālayāmāsa dharmātmā sve sve karmaṇyavasthitāḥ
duṣṭaiṣu daṇḍaṃ śiṣṭeṣu samyak ca paripālanam / kurvan parāṃ mudaṃ lebhe iyāja ca mahāmakhaiḥ
ajāyanta sutāścāsya mahābalaparākramāḥ / dharmātmāno māhatmāno vimārgaparipanthinaḥ
cakāra sor'thaṃ dharmeṇa dharmamarthena vā punaḥ / tayoścaivāvirodhena bubhuje viṣayānapi
evaṃ bahūni varṣāṇi tasya pālayato mahīm / dharmārthakāmasaktasya jagmurekamaharyathā
vairāgyaṃ nāsya sañjajñe bhuñjato viṣayān priyān / na cāpyalamabhūttasya dharmārthopārjanaṃ prati
taṃ tathā bhogasaṃsarga-pramattamajitendriyam / subāhurnāma śuśrāva bhrātā tasya vanecaraḥ
taṃ bubodhayiṣuḥ so 'tha ciraṃ dhyātvā mahīpatiḥ / tadvairisaṃśrayaṃ tasya śreyo 'manyata bhūpateḥ
tataḥ sa kāśibhūpālamudīrṇabalavāhanam / svarājyaṃ prāptumāgacchad bahuśaḥ śaraṇaṃ kṛtī
so 'pi cakre balodyogamalarkaṃ prati pārthivaḥ / dūtañca preṣayāmāsa rājyamasmai pradīyatām
so 'pi naicchattadā dātumājñāpūrvaṃ svadharmavit / pratyuvāca ca taṃ dūtamalarkaḥ kāśibhūbhṛtaḥ
māmevābhyetya hārdena yācatāṃ rājyamagrajaḥ / nākrāntyā saṃpradāsyāmi bhayenālpāmapi kṣitim
subāhurapi no yāñcāṃ cakāra matimāṃstadā / na dharmaḥ kṣatriyasyeti yāñcā vīryadhano hi saḥ
tataḥ samastasainyena kāśīśaḥ parivāritaḥ / ākrāntumabhyagādrāṣṭramalarkasya mahīpateḥ
anantaraiśca saṃśleṣamabhyetya tadanantaram / teṣāmanyatamairbhṛtyaiḥ samākramyānayadvaśam
apīḍayaṃśca sāmāntāṃstasya rāṣṭroparodhanaiḥ / tathā durgānupālāṃśca cakre cāṭavikān vaśe
kāṃściccopapradānena kāṃścid bhedena pārthivān / sāmnaivānyān vaśaṃ ninye nibhṛtāstasya ye 'bhavan
tataḥ so 'lpabalo rājā paracakrāvapījitaḥ / koṣakṣayamavāpoccaiḥ purañcārudhyatāriṇā
itthaṃ sampīḍyamānastu kṣīṇakoṣo dine dine / viṣādamāgātparamaṃ vyākulatvañca cetasaḥ
ārti sa paramāṃ prāpya tat sasmārāṅgulīyakam / yaduddiśya purā prāha mātā tasya madālasā
tataḥ strātaḥ śucirbhūtvā vācayitvā dvijottamān / niṣkṛṣya śāsanaṃ tasmāddadṛśe prasphuṭākṣaram
tatraiva likhitaṃ mātrā vācayāmāsa pārthivaḥ / prakāśapulakāṅgo 'sau praharṣotphullalocanaḥ
saṅgaḥ sarvātmanā tyājyaḥ sa cettyaktuṃ na śakyate / sa sadibhaḥ saha kartavyaḥ satāṃ saṅgo hi bheṣajam
kāmaḥ sarvātmanā heyo hātuñcecchakyate na saḥ / mumukṣāṃ prati tatkāryaṃ saiva tasyāpi bheṣajam
vācayitvā tu bahuśo nṛṇāṃ śreyaḥ kathaṃ tviti / mumukṣayeti niścitya sā ca tatsaṅgato yataḥ
tataḥ sa sādhusamparkaṃ cintayan pṛthivīpatiḥ / dattātreyaṃ mahābhāgamagacchat paramārtimān
taṃ sametya mahātmānamakalpaṣamasaṅginam / praṇipatyābhisampūjya yathānyāyamabhāṣata
brahman ! kuru prasādaṃ me śaraṇaṃ śaraṇārthinām / duḥ khāpahāraṃ kuru me duḥ khārtasyātikāminaḥ
duḥ khāpahāramadyaiva karomi tava pārthiva ! / satyaṃ brūhi kimarthaṃ te duḥ khaṃ tat pṛthivīpate
jaḍa uvāca ityuktaścintayāmāsa sa rājā tena dhīmatā / trividhasyāpi duḥ khasya sthānamātmānameva ca
sa vimṛṣya ciraṃ rājā punaḥ punarudāradhīḥ / ātmānamātmanā dhīraḥ prahasyedamathābrāvīt
nāhamurvo na salilaṃ na jyotiranilo na ca / nākāśaṃ kintu śārīraṃ sametya sukhamiṣyate
nyūnātiriktatāṃ yāti pañcake 'smin sukhāsukham / yadi syānma kinna syādanyasthe 'pi hi tanmayi
nityaprabhūtasadbhāve nyūnādhikyānnatonnate / tathā ca mamatātyakte viśeṣo nopalabhyate
tanmātrāvasthite sūkṣme tṛtīyāṃśe ca paśyataḥ / tathaiva bhūtasadbhāvaṃ śarīraṃ kiṃ sukhāsukham
manasyavasthitaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ vā mānasañca yat / yatastato na me duḥ khaṃ sukhaṃ vā nahyahaṃ manaḥ
nāhaṅkāro na ca mano buddhirnāhaṃ yatastataḥ / antaḥ karaṇajaṃ duḥ khaṃ pārakhyaṃ mama tatkatham
nāhaṃ śarīraṃ na mano yato 'haṃ pṛthak śarīrānmanasastathāham / tat santu cetasyathavāpi dehe sukhāni duḥ khāni ca kiṃ mamātra
rājyasya vāñchāṃ surute 'grajo 'sya dehasya cet pañcamayaḥ sa rāśiḥ / guṇapravṛttyā mama kinnu tatra tatsthaḥ sa cāhañca śarīrato 'nyaḥ
na yasya hastādikamapyaśeṣaṃ māṃsaṃ na cāsthīni khirāvibhāgaḥ / kastasya nāgāśvarathādikoṣaiḥ svalpo 'pi sambandha ihāsti puṃsaḥ
tasmānna me 'rirna ca me 'sti duḥ khaṃ na me sukhaṃ nāpi puraṃ na koṣam / na cāśvanāgādi balaṃ na tasya nānyasya vā kasyacidvā mamāsti
yathā ghaṭīkumbhakamaṇḍalustham ākāśamekaṃ bahudhā hi dṛṣṭam / tathā subāhuḥ sa ca kāśipo 'haṃ malye ca deheṣu śarīrabhedaiḥ

iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe pitāputrasaṃvāde ātmaviveko nāma saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ aṣṭatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ jaḍa uvāca dattātreyaṃ tato vipraṃ praṇipatya sa pārthivaḥ / pratyuvāca mahātmānaṃ praśrayāvanato vacaḥ
samyak prapaśyato brahman ! mama duḥ khaṃ na kiñcana / asamyagdarśinā magnāḥ sarvadaivāsukhārṇave
yasmin yasminmamāsaktā buddhiḥ puṃsaḥ prajāyate / tatastataḥ samādāya duḥ khānyeva prayacchati
mārjārabhakṣite duḥ khaṃ yādṛśaṃ gṛhakukkuṭe / na tādṛṅmamatāśūnye kalaviṅke 'tha mūṣike
so 'haṃ na duḥ khī na sukhī yato 'haṃ prakṛteḥ paraḥ / yo bhūtābhibhavo bhūtaiḥ sukhaduḥ khātmako hi saḥ
dattātreya uvāca evametannaravyāghra ! yathaitadvyāhṛtaṃ tvayā / mameti mūlaṃ duḥ kasya na mameti ca nirvṛteḥ
matpraśnādeva te jñānamutpannamidamuttamam / mameti pratyayo yena kṣiptaḥ śālmalitūlavat
ahamityaṅkurotpanno mameti skandhavān mahān / gṛhakṣetroccaśākhaśca putradārādipallavaḥ
dhanadhānyamahāpatro naikakālapravardhitaḥ / puṇyāpuṇyāgrapuṣpaśca sukhaduḥ khamahāphalaḥ
tatra muktipathavyāpi mūḍhasamparkasecanaḥ / vidhitsābhṛṅgamālāḍhyo kṛtyajñānamahātaruḥ
saṃsārādhvapariśrāntā ye tacchāyāṃ samāśritāḥ / bhrāntijñānasukhādhīnāsteṣāmātyantikaṃ kutaḥ
yaistu satsaṅgapāṣāṇaśitena mamatātaruḥ / chinno vidyākuṭhāreṇa te gatāstena vartmanā
prāpya brahmavanaṃ śītaṃ nīrajaskamakaṇṭakam / prāpnuvanti parāṃ prājñā nirvṛtiṃ vṛttivarjitāḥ
bhūtendriyamayaṃ sthūlaṃ na tvaṃ rājanna cāpyaham / na tanmātramayāvāvāṃ naivāntaḥ karaṇātmakau
kaṃ vā paśyāmi rājendra ! pradhānamidamāvayoḥ / yataḥ paro hi kṣetrajñaḥ saṅghāto hi guṇātmakaḥ
maśakoḍumbareṣīkāmuñjamatsyāmbhasāṃ yathā / ekatve 'pi pṛthagbhāvastathā kṣetrātmanornṛpa !
alarka uvāca bhagavaṃstvatprasādena mamāvirbhūtamuttamam / jñānaṃ pradhānacicchakti-vivekakaramīdṛśam
kintvatra viṣayākrānte sthairyavattvaṃ na cetasi / na cāpi vedmi mucyeyaṃ kathaṃ prakṛtibandhanāt
kathaṃ na bhūyāṃ bhūyaśca kathaṃ nirguṇatāmiyām / kathañca brahmaṇaikatvaṃ vrajeyaṃ śāśvatena vai
tanme yogantathā brahman ! praṇatāyābhiyācate / samyag brūhi mahāprājña ! satsaṅgo hyupakṛnnṛṇām
iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe pitāputrasaṃvāde praśnādhyāyo nāmāṣṭatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ éééåßñ/ yuñjataśca sadā yogaṃ yādṛgvihitamāsanam
padmamardhāsanañcāpi tathā svastikamāsanam / āsthāya yogaṃ yuñjīta kṛtvā ca praṇavaṃ hṛdi
samaḥ samāsano bhūtvā saṃhṛtya caraṇāvubhau / saṃvṛtāsyastathaivorū samyagviṣṭabhya cāgrataḥ
pārṣṇibhyāṃ liṅgavṛṣaṇāvaspṛśan prayataḥ sthitaḥ / kiñcidunnāmitaśirā dantairdantānna saṃspṛśet
sampaśyan nāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaścānavalokayan / rajasā tamaso vṛttiṃ sattvena rajasastathā
sañchādya nirmale sattve sthito yuñjīta yogavit / indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyaḥ prāṇādīnmana eva ca
nigṛhya samavāyena pratyāhāramupakramet / yastu pratyāharetkāmāna sarvāṅgānīva kacchapaḥ
sadātmaratirekasthaḥ vaśyatyātmānamātmani / sa bāhyābhyantaraṃ śaucaṃ niṣpādyākaṇṭhanābhitaḥ
pūrayitvā budho dehaṃ pratyāhāramupakramet / prāṇāyāmā daśa dvau ca dhāraṇā sābhidhīyate
dve dhāraṇe smṛte yoge yogibhistattvadṛṣṭibhiḥ / tathā vai yogayuktasya yogino niyatātmanaḥ
sarve doṣāḥ praṇaśyanti svasthaścaivopajāyate / vīkṣate ca paraṃ brahma prākṛtāṃśca guṇān pṛthak
vyomādiparamāṇūṃśca tathātmānamakalmaṣam / itthaṃ yogī yatāhāraḥ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇaḥ
jitāṃ jitāṃ śanairbhūmimāroheta yathā gṛham / doṣān vyādhīṃstathā mohamākrāntā bhūranirjitā
vivardhayati nārohettasmād bhūmimanirjitām / prāṇānāmupasaṃrodhāt prāṇāyāma iti smṛtaḥ
dhāraṇetyucyate ceyaṃ dhāryate yanmano yathā / śabdādibhyaḥ pravṛttāni yadakṣāṇi yatātmabhiḥ
pratyāhriyante yogena pratyāhārastataḥ smṛtaḥ / upāyaścātra kathito yogibhiḥ paramarṣibhiḥ
yena vyādhyādayo doṣā na jāyante hi yoginaḥ / yathā toyārthinastoyaṃ yantranālādibhiḥ śanaiḥ
āpibeyustathā vāyuṃ pibedyogī jitaśramaḥ / prāṅnābhyāṃ hṛdaye cātra tṛtīye ca tathorasi
kaṇṭhe mukhe nāsikāgre netrabhrūmadhyamūrdhasu / kiñca tasmātparasmiṃśca dhāraṇā paramā smṛtā
daśaitā dhāraṇā prāpya prāprotyakṣarasāmyatām / nādhmātaḥ kṣudhitaḥ śrānto na ca vyākulacetanaḥ
yuñjīta yogaṃ rājendra ! yogī siddhyarthamādṛtaḥ / nātiśīte na coṣṇe vai na dvandve nānilātmake
kāleṣveteṣu yuñjīta na yogaṃ dhyānatatparaḥ / saśabdāgnijālabhyāse jīrṇagoṣṭhe catuṣpathe
śuṣkaparṇacaye nadyāṃ śmaśāne sasarīsṛpe / sabhaye kūpatīre vā caityavalmīkasañcaye
deśeṣveteṣu tattvajño yogābhyāsaṃ vivarjayet / sattvasyānupapattau ca deśakālaṃ vivarjayet
nāsato darśanaṃ yoge tasmāttatparivarjayet / deśānetānanādṛtya mūḍhatvādyo yunakti vai
vighrāya tasya vai doṣā jāyante tannibodha me / bādhiryaṃ jaḍatā lopaḥ smṛtermūkatvamandhatā
jvaraśca jāyate sadyastattadajñānayoginaḥ / pramādādyogino doṣā yadyete syuścikitsitam
teṣāṃ nāśāya kartavyaṃ yogināṃ tannibodha me / strigdhāṃ yavāgūmatyuṣṇāṃ bhuktvā tatraiva dhārayet
vāta-gulmapraśāntyarthamudāvarte tathodare / yavāgūṃ vāpi pavanaṃ vāyugranthiṃ pratikṣipet
tadvatkampe mahāśailaṃ sthiraṃ manasi dhārayet / vighāte vacaso vācaṃ bādhirye śravaṇendriyam
yathaivāmraphalaṃ dhyāyet tṛṣṇārto rasanendriye / yasmin yasmin rujā dehe tasmiṃstadupakāriṇīm
dhārayeddhāraṇāmuṣṇe śītāṃ śīte ca dāhinīm / kīlaṃ śirasi saṃsthāpya kāṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭhena tāḍayet
luptasmṛteḥ smṛtiḥ sadyo yoginastena jāyate / dyāvāpṛthivyau vāyvagrī vyāpināvapi dhārayet
amānuṣāt sattvajādvā bādhāstvetāścikitsitāḥ / amānuṣaṃ sattvamantaryoginaṃ praviśedyadi
vāyvagrīdhāraṇenainaṃ dehasaṃsthaṃ vinirdahet / evaṃ sarvātmanā rakṣā kāryā yogavidā nṛpa !
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ śarīraṃ sādhanaṃ yataḥ / pravṛttilakṣaṇākhyānādyogino vismayāttathā / vijñānaṃ vilayaṃ yāti tasmād gopyāḥ pravṛttayaḥ
ālolyamārogyamaniṣṭhuratvaṃ gandhaḥ śubho mūtrapurīṣamalpam / kāntiḥ prasādaḥ svarasaumyatā ca yogapravṛtteḥ prathamaṃ hi cihnam
anurāgī jano yāti parokṣe guṇakīrtanam / na babhyati ca sattvāni siddherlakṣaṇamuttamam
śītoṣṇādibhiratyugrairyasya bādhā na vidyate / na bhītimeti cānyebhyastasya siddhirupasthitā

iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe jaḍopākhyāne yogādhyāyo nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ dattātreya uvāca upasargāḥ pravartante dṛṣṭe hyātmani yoginaḥ / ye tāṃste saṃpravakṣyāmi samāsena nibodha me
kāmyāḥ kriyāstathā kāmān mānuṣānabhivāñchati / striyo dānaphalaṃ vidyāṃ māyāṃ kupyaṃ dhanaṃ divam
devatvamamareśatvaṃ rasāyanacayāḥ kriyāḥ / marutprapatanaṃ yajñaṃ jalagnyāveśanantathā
śrāddhānāṃ sarvadānānāṃ phalāni niyamāṃstathā / tathopavāsāt pūrtācca devatābhyarccanādapi
tebhyastebhyaśca karmabhya upasṛṣṭo 'bhivāñchati / cittamitthaṃ vartamānaṃ yatnādyogī nivartayet
brahmasaṅgimanaḥ kurvannupasargāt pramucyate / upasargairjitairebhirupasargāstataḥ punaḥ
yoginaḥ saṃpravartante sāttvarājasatāmasāḥ / prātibhiḥ śrāvaṇo daivo bhramāvattau tathāparau
pañcaite yogināṃ yogavighrāya kaṭukodayāḥ / vedārthāḥ kāvyaśāstrārthā vidyāśilpānyaśeṣataḥ
pratibhānti yadasyeti prātibhaḥ sa tu yoginaḥ / śabdārthānākhilān vetti śabdaṃ gṛhṇāti caiva yat
yojanānāṃ sahasrebhyaḥ śrāvaṇaḥ so 'bhidhīyate / mamantādvīkṣate cāṣṭau sa yadā devatopamaḥ
upasargantamapyāhurdaivamunmattavad budhāḥ / bhrāmyate yannirālambaṃ mano doṣeṇa yoginaḥ
samastācāravibhrāṃśād bhramaḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ / āvarta iva toyasya jñānāvarto yadākulaḥ
nāśayeccittamāvarta upasargaḥ sa ucyate / etairnāśitayogāstu sakalā devayonayaḥ
upasargairmahāghorairāvartante punaḥ punaḥ / prāvṛtya kambalaṃ śuklaṃ yogī tasmānmanomayam
cintayet paramaṃ brahma kṛtvā tatpravaṇaṃ manaḥ / yogayuktaḥ sadā yogī laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ
sūkṣmāstu dhāraṇāḥ sapta bhūrādyā mūrghni dhārayet / dharitrīṃ dhārayedyogī tat saukṣmyaṃ pratipadyate
ātmānaṃ manyate corvoṃ tadgandhañca jahāti saḥ / yathaivāpsu rasaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tadvadrūpañca tejasi
sparśaṃ vāyo tathā tadvadvibhratastasya dhāraṇām / vyomraḥ sūkṣmāṃ pravṛttiñca śabdaṃ tadvajjahāti saḥ
manasā sarvabhūtānāṃ manasyāviśate yadā / mānasīṃ dhāraṇāṃ bibhranmanaḥ sūkṣmañca jāyate
tadvad buddhimaśeṣāṇāṃ sattvānāmetya yogavit / parityajati samprāpya buddhisaukṣmyamanuttamam
parityajati sūkṣmāṇi sapta tvetāni yogavit / samyagvijñāya yo 'larka ! tasyāvṛttirna vidyate
etāsāṃ dhāraṇānāntu saptānāṃ saukṣmyamātmavān / dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā tataḥ siddhiṃ tyaktvā tyaktvā parāṃ vrajet
yasmin yasmiṃśca kurute bhūte rāgaṃ mahīpate / tasmiṃstasmin samāsaktiṃ saṃprāpya sa vinaśyati
tasmādviditvā sūkṣmāṇi saṃsaktāni parasparam / parityajati yo dehī sa paraṃ prāpnuyāt padam
etānyeva tu sandhāya sapta sūkṣmāṇi pārthiva ! / bhūtādīnāṃ virāgo 'tra sadbhāvajñasya muktaye
gandhādiṣu samāsaktiṃ samprāpya sa vinaśyati / punarāvartate bhūpa ! sa brahmāparamānuṣam
saptaitā dhāraṇā yogī samatītya yadicchati / tasmiṃstasmiṃllayaṃ sūkṣme bhūte yāti nareśvara !
devānāmasurāṇāṃ vā gandharvoragarakṣasām / deheṣu layamāyāti saṅgaṃ nāproti ca kvacit
aṇimā laghimā caiva mahimā prāptireva ca / prākāmyaṃ ca tatheśitvaṃ vaśitvañca tathāparam
yatrakāmāvasāyitvaṃ guṇānetāṃstathaiśvarān / prāpnotyaṣṭau naravyāghra ! paraṃ nirvāṇasūcakān
sūkṣmāt sūkṣmatamo 'ṇīyān śīghratvaṃ laghimā guṇaḥ / mahimāśeṣapūjyatvāt prāptirnāprāpyamasya yat
prākāmyamasya vyāpitvādīśitvañceśvaro yataḥ / vakhitvādvaśimā nāma yoginaḥ saptamo guṇaḥ
yatrecchāsthānamapyuktaṃ yatrakāmāvasāyitā / aiśvaryakāraṇairebhiryoginaḥ proktamaṣṭadhā
muktisaṃsūcakaṃ bhūpa ! paraṃ nirvāṇamātmanaḥ / tato na jāyate naiva vardhate na vinaśyati
nāpi kṣayamavāproti pariṇāmaṃ na gacchati / chedaṃ kledaṃ tathā dāhaṃ śoṣaṃ bhūrādito na ca
bhūtavargādavāpnoti śabdādyaiḥ hriyate na ca / na cāsya santi śabdādyāstadbhoktā tairna yujyate
yathāhi kanakaṃ khaṇḍamapadravyavadagninā / dagdhadoṣaṃ dvitīyena khaṇḍenaikyaṃ vrajennṛpa
na viśeṣamavāproti tadvadyogāgninā yatiḥ / nirdagdhadoṣastenaikyaṃ prayāti brahmaṇā saha
yathāgniragnau saṃkṣiptaḥ samānatvamanuvrajet / tadākhyastanmayo bhūto na gṛhyeta viśeṣataḥ
pareṇa brahmaṇā tadvat prāpyaikyaṃ dagdhakilviṣaḥ / yogī yāti pṛthagbhāvaṃ na kadācinmahīpate !
yathā jalaṃ jalenaikyaṃ nikṣiptamupagacchati / tathātmā sāmyamabhyeti yoginaḥ paramātmani
iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe yogasiddhirnāma catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ekacatvāriśo 'dhyāyaḥ alarka uvāca bhagavan ! yoginaścaryāṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ / brahmavartmanyanusaran yathā yogī na sīdati
dattātreya uvāca mānāpamānau yāvetau pratyudvegakarau nṛṇām / tāveva viparītārthau yoginaḥ siddhikārakau
mānāpamānau yāvetau tāvevāhurviṣāmṛte / apamāno 'mṛtaṃ tatra mānastu viṣamaṃ viṣam
cakṣuḥ pūtaṃ nyasetpādaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet / satyapūtāṃ vadedvāṇīṃ buddhipūtañca cintayet
ātithyaśrāddhayajñeṣu devayātrotsaveṣu ca / mahājanañca siddhyarthaṃ na gacchedyogavit kvacit
vyaste vidhūme vyaṅgāre sarvasmin bhuktavajjane / aṭeta yogavid bhaikṣyaṃ na tu triṣveva nityaśaḥ
yathaivamavamanyante janāḥ paribhavanti ca / tathā yuktaścaredyogī satāṃ vartma na dūṣayan
bhaikṣyañcared gṛhastheṣu yāyāvaragṛheṣu ca / śreṣṭhā tu prathamā ceti vṛttirasyopadiśyate
atha nityaṃ gṛhastheṣu śālīneṣu caredyatiḥ / śraddadhāneṣu dānteṣu śrotriyeṣu mahātmasu
ata ūrdhvaṃ puścāpi aduṣṭāpatiteṣu ca / bhaikṣyacaryā vivarṇeṣu jaghanyā vṛttiriṣyate
bhaikṣyaṃ yavāgūṃ takraṃ vā payo yāvakameva vā / phalaṃ mūlaṃ priyaṅguṃ vā kaṇapiṇyākasaktavaḥ
ityete ca śubhāhārā yoginaḥ siddhikārakāḥ / tat prayuñjyānmunirbhaktyā parameṇa samādhinā
apaḥ pūrvaṃ sakṛt prāśya tūṣṇīṃ bhūtvā samāhitaḥ / prāṇāyeti tatastasya prathamā hyāhutiḥ smṛtā
apānāya dvitīyā tu samānāyate cāparā / udānāya caturtho syādvyānāyeti ca pañcamī
prāṇāyāmaiḥ pṛthak kṛtvā śeṣaṃ bhuñjīta kāmataḥ / apaḥ punaḥ sakṛt praśya ācamya hṛdayaṃ spṛśet
asteyaṃ brahmacaryañca tyāgo 'lobhastathaiva ca / vratāni pañca bhikṣūṇāmahiṃsāparamāṇi vai
akrodho guruśuśrūṣā śaucamāhāralāghavam / nityasvādhyāya ityete niyamāḥ pañca kīrtitāḥ
sārabhūtamupāsīta jñānaṃ yatkāryasādhakam / jñānānāṃ bahutā yeyaṃ yogavighrakarā hi sā
idaṃ jñeyamidaṃ jñeyamiti yastṛṣitaścaret / api kalpasahasreṣu naiva jñeyamavāpnuyāt
tyaktasaṅgo jitakrodho laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ / pidhāya buddhyā dvārāṇi mano dhyāne niveśayet
śūnyeṣvevāvakāśeṣu guhāsu ca vaneṣu ca / nityayuktaḥ sadā yogī dhyānaṃ samyagupakramet
vāgdaṇḍaḥ karmadaṇḍaśca manodaṇḍaśca te trayaḥ / yasyaite niyatā daṇḍāḥ sa tridaṇḍī mahāyatiḥ
sarvamātmamayaṃ yasya sadasajjagadīdṛśam / guṇāguṇamayantasya kaḥ priyaḥ ko nṛpāpriyaḥ
visuddhabuddhiḥ samaloṣṭakāñcanaḥ samastabhūteṣu ca tatsamāhitaḥ / sthānaṃ paraṃ śāśvatamavyayañca paraṃ hi matvā na punaḥ prajāyate
vedācchreṣṭhāḥ sarvayajñakriyāśca yajñājjapyaṃ jñānamārgaśca japyāt / jñānāddhyānaṃ saṅgarāgavyapetaṃ tasmin prāpte śāśvatasyopalabdhiḥ
samāhito brahmaparo 'pramādī sucistathaikāntaratiryatendriyaḥ / samāpnuyādyogamimaṃ mahātmā vimuktimāproti tataḥ svayogataḥ
iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe yogicaryānāmaikacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ dvicatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ dattātreya uvāca evaṃ yo vartate yogī samyagyogavyavasthitaḥ / na sa vyāvartituṃ śakyo janmāntaraśatairapi
dṛṣṭvā ca paramātmānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ viśvarūpiṇam / viśvapādaśirogrīvaṃ viśveśaṃ viśvabhāvanam
tatprāptaye mahatpuṇyamomityekākṣaraṃ japet / tadevādhyayanaṃ tasya svarūpaṃ śṛṇvataḥ param
akāraśca tathokāro makāraścākṣaratrayam / etā eva trayo mātrāḥ sāttvarājasatāmasāḥ
nirguṇā yogigamyānyā cārdhamātrordhvasaṃsthitā / gāndhārīti ca vijñeyā gāndhārasvarasaṃśrayā
pipīlikāgatisparśā prayuktā mūrdhni lakṣyate / yathā prayukta oṅgāraḥ pratiniryāti mūrdhani
tathoṅkāramayo yogī tvakṣare tvakṣaro bhavet / prāṇo dhanuḥ śaro hyātmā brahma vedhyamanuttamam
apramattena veddhavyaṃ śaravattanmayo bhavet / omityetat trayo vedāstrayo lokāstrayo 'gnayaḥ
viṣṇur-brahmā-haraścaiva ṛksāmāni yajūṃṣi ca / mātrāḥ sārdhāśca tistraśca vijñeyāḥ paramārthataḥ
tatra yuktastu yo yogī sa tallayamavāpnuyāt / akārastvatha bhūrloka ukāraścocyate bhuvaḥ
savyañjano makāraśca svarlokaḥ parikalpyate / vyaktā tu prathamā mātrā dvitīyāvyaktasaṃjñitā
mātrā tṛtīyā cicchaktirardhamātrā paraṃ padam / anenaiva krameṇaitā vijñeyā yogabhūmayaḥ
omityuccāraṇāt sarvaṃ gṛhītaṃ sadasad bhavet / hrasvā tu prathamā mātrā dvitīyā dairghyasaṃyutā
tṛtīyā ca plutārdhākhyā vacasaḥ sā na gocarā / ityetadakṣaraṃ brahma paramoṅkārasaṃjñitam
yastu veda naraḥ samyak tathā dhyāyati vā punaḥ / saṃsāracakramutsṛjya tyaktatrividhabandhanaḥ
prāproti brahmaṇi layaṃ parame paramātmani / akṣīṇakarmabandhaśca jñātvā mṛtyumariṣṭataḥ
utkrāntikāle saṃsmṛtya punaryogitvamṛcchati / tasmādasiddhayogena siddhayogena vā punaḥ / jñeyanyariṣṭāni sadā yenotkrāntau na sīdati

iti śrīmārkaṇāḍeyapurāṇe yogadharme oṅkāradhyāyo nāma dvicatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ dattātreya uvāca ariṣṭāni mahārāja ! śṛṇu vakṣyāmi tāni te / yeṣāmālokanānmṛtyuṃ nijaṃ jānāti yogavit
devamārgaṃ dhruvaṃ śukraṃ somacchāyāmarundhatīm / yo na paśyenna jīvet sa naraḥ saṃvatsarāt param
araśmibimbaṃ sūryasya vahniṃ caivāṃśumālinam / dṛṣṭvai kādaśamāsāt tu naro nordhantu jīvati
vānte mūtrapūrīṣe ca yaḥ svarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā / pratyakṣaṃ kurute svapne jīvet sa daśamāsikam
dṛṣṭvā pretapiśācādīn gandharvanagarāṇi ca / suvarṇavarṇān vṛkṣāṃśca nava māsān sa jīvati
sthūlaḥ kṛśaḥ kṛśaḥ sthūlo yo 'kasmādeva jāyate / prakṛteśca nivarteta tasyāyuścāṣṭamāsikam
khaṇḍaṃ yasya padaṃ pārṣṇayāṃ pādasyāgre ca vā bhavet / pāṃśukardamayormadhye sapta māsān sa jīvati
gṛdhraḥ kapotaḥ kākālo vāyaso vāpi mūrdhani / kravyādo vā khago nīlaḥ ṣaṇmāsāyuḥ pradarśakaḥ
hanyate kākapaṅktībhiḥ pāṃśuvarṣeṇa vā naraḥ / svāṃ cchāyāmanyathā dṛṣṭvā catuḥ pañca sa jīvati
anabhre vidyutaṃ dṛṣṭvā dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritām / rātrāvindradhanuścāpi jīvitaṃ dvitrimāsikam
ghṛte taile tathādarśe toye vā nātmanastanum / yaḥ paśyedaśiraskāṃ vā māsādūrdhvaṃ na jīvati
yasya vastasamo gandho gātre śavasamo 'pi vā / tasyārdhamāsikaṃ jñeyaṃ yogino nṛpa ! jīvitam
yasya vai stramātrasya hṛtpādamavaśuṣyate / pibataśca jalaṃ śoṣo daśāhaṃ so 'pi jīvati
sambhinno māruto yasya marmasthānāni kṛntati / hṛṣyate nāmbusaṃsparśāt tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ
ṛkṣavānarayānastho gāyan yo dakṣiṇāṃ diśam / svapne prayāti tasyāpi na mṛtyuḥ kālamicchati
raktakṛṣṇāmbaradharā gāyantī hasatī ca yam / dakṣiṇāśānnayennārī svapne so 'pi na jīvati
nagnaṃ kṣapaṇakaṃ svapne hasamānaṃ mahābalam / ekaṃ saṃvīkṣya valgantaṃ vidyānmṛtyumupasthitam
āmastakatalādyastu nimagnaṃ paṅkasāgare / svapne paśyatyathātmānaṃ sa sadyo mriyate naraḥ
keśāṅgārāṃstathā bhasma bhujaṅgānnirjalāṃ nadīm / dṛṣṭvā svapne daśāhāttu mṛtyurekādaśe dine
karālairvikaṭaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ puruṣairudyatāyudhaiḥ / pāṣāṇaistāḍitaḥ svapne sadyo mṛtyuṃ labhennaraḥ
sūryodaye yasya śivā krośantī yāti saṃmukham / viparītaṃ parītaṃ vā sa sadyo mṛtyumṛcchati
yasya vai bhuktamātrasya hṛdayaṃ bādhate kṣudhā / jāyate dantagharṣaśca sa gatāyurna saṃśayam
dīpagandhaṃ na yo vetti trasyatyahni tathā niśi / nātmānaṃ paranetrasthaṃ vīkṣate na sa jīvati
śakrāyudhaṃ cārdharātre divā grahagaṇantathā / dṛṣṭvā manyeta saṃkṣīṇamātmajīvitamātmavit
nāsikā vakratāmeti karṇayornamanonnatī / netrañca vāmaṃ stravati yasya tasyāyurudgatam
āraktatāmeti mukhaṃ jihvā vā śyāmatāṃ yadā / tadā prājño vijānīyānmṛtyumāsannamātmanaḥ
uṣṭra-rāsabhayānena yaḥ svapne dakṣiṇāṃ diśam / prayāti tañca jānīyāt sadyomṛtyuṃ na saṃśayaḥ
pidhāya karṇau nirghoṣaṃ na śṛṇotyātmasambhavam / naśyate cakṣuṣorjyotiryasya so 'pi na jīvati
patato yasya vai garte svapne dvāraṃ pidhīyate / na cottiṣṭhati yaḥ śvabhrāttadantaṃ tasya jīvitam
ūrdhvā ca dṛṣṭirna ca saṃpratiṣṭhā raktā punaḥ saṃparivartamānā / mukhasya coṣmā śuṣirañca nābheḥ śaṃsanti puṃsāmaparaṃ śarīram
svapne 'gniṃ praviśedyastu na ca niṣkramate punaḥ / jalapraveśādapi vā tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam
yaścābhihanyate duṣṭairbhūtai rātrāvatho divā / sa mṛtyuṃ saptarātryante naraḥ prāprotyasaṃśayam
svavastramamalaṃ śuklaṃ raktaṃ paśyatyathāsitam / yaḥ pumān mṛtyumāsannaṃ tasyāpi hi vinirdiśet
svabhāvavaiparītyantu prakṛteśca viparyayaḥ / kathayanti manuṣyāṇāṃ sadāsannau yamāntakau
yeṣāṃ vinītaḥ satataṃ ye 'sya pūjyatamā matāḥ / tāneva cāvajānāti tāneva ca vinindati
devānnārcayate vṛddhān gurūn viprāṃśca nindati / mātāpitrorna satkāraṃ jāmātṝṇāṃ karoti ca
yogināṃ jñānaviduṣāmanyeṣāñca mahātmanām / prāpte tu kāle puruṣastadvijñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ
yogināṃ satataṃ yatnādariṣṭānyavanīpate / saṃvatsarānte tajjñeyaṃ phaladāni divāniśam
vilokyā viśadā caiṣāṃ phalapaṅktiḥ subhīṣaṇā / vijñāya kāryo manasi sa ca kālo nareśvara
jñātva kālañca taṃ samyagabhayasthānamāśritaḥ / yuñjīta yogī kālo 'sau yathā nāsyāphalo bhavet
dṛṣṭvāriṣṭaṃ tathā yogī tyaktvā maraṇajaṃ bhayam / tatsvabhāvaṃ tadālokya kāle yāvatyupāgatam
tasya bhāge tathaivāhno yogaṃ yuñjīta yogavit / pūrvāhne cāparāhne ca madhyāhne cāpi taddine
yatra vā rajanībhāge tadariṣṭaṃ nirīkṣitam / tatraiva tāvadyuñjīta yāvat prāptaṃ hi taddinam
tatastyaktvā bhayaṃ sarvaṃ jitvā taṃ kālamātmavān / tatraivāvasathe sthitvā yatra vā sthairyamātmanaḥ
yuñjīta yogaṃ nirjitya trīn guṇān paramātmani / tanmayaścātmanā bhūtvā cidvṛttimapi santyajet
tataḥ paramanirvāṇamatīndriyamagocaram / yadbuddheryanna cākhyātuṃ śakyate tat samaśnute
etat sarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ tavālarka ! yathārthavat / prāpsyase yena tadbrahma saṃkṣepāttannibodha me
śaśāṅkaraśmisaṃyogācchandrakāntamaṇiḥ payaḥ / samutsṛjati nāyuktaḥ sopamā yoginaḥ smṛtā
yaccārkaraśmisaṃyogādarkakānto hutāśanam / āviṣkaroti naikaḥ sannupamā sāpi yoginaḥ
pipīlikākhu-nakula-gṛhagodhā-kapiñjalāḥ / vasanti svāmivad gehe dhvaste yānti tato 'nyataḥ
duḥ khantu svāmino dhvaṃse tasya teṣāṃ na kiñcana / veśmano yatra rājendra ! sopamā yogasiddhaye
mṛdvāhikālpadehāpi mukhāgreṇāpyaṇīyasā / karoti mṛdbhāracayamupadeśaḥ sa yoginaḥ
paśupakṣimanuṣyādyaiḥ patrapuṣpaphalānvitam / vṛkṣaṃ vilupyamānantu dṛṣṭvā sidhyanti yoginaḥ
ruruśāvaviṣāṇāgramālakṣya tilakākṛtim / saha tena vivardhantaṃ yogī siddhimavāpnuyāt
dravapūrṇamupādāya pātramārohato bhuvaḥ / tuṅgamārgaṃ vilokyoccairvijñātaṃ kiṃ na yoginā
sarvasve jīvanāyālaṃ nikhāte puruṣasya yā / ceṣṭā tāṃ tattvato jñātvā yoginaḥ kṛtakṛtyatā
tadgṛhaṃ yatra vasatiḥ tadbhojyaṃ yena jīvati / yena sampadyate cārthastatsukhaṃ mamatātra kā
abhyarthito 'pi taiḥ kāryaṃ karoti karaṇairyathā / tathā budhyādibhiryogī pārakyaiḥ sādhayetparam
jaḍa uvāca tataḥ praṇamyātriputramalarkaḥ sa mahīpatiḥ / praśrayāvanato vākyamuvācātimudānvitaḥ
alarka uvāca diṣṭyādevairidaṃ brahman ! parābhibhavasambhavam / upapāditamatyugraṃ prāṇasandehadaṃ bhayam
diṣṭyā kāśipaterbhūri-balasampatparākramaḥ / yaducchedādihāyātaḥ sa yuṣmatsaṅgado mama
diṣṭyā mandabalaścāhaṃ diṣṭyā bhṛtyāśca me hatāḥ / diṣṭyā koṣaḥ kṣayaṃ yoto diṣṭyāhaṃ bhītimāgataḥ
diṣṭyā tvatpādayugalaṃ mama smṛtipathaṃ gatam / diṣṭyā tvaduktayaḥ sarvā mama cetasi saṃsthitaḥ
diṣṭyā jñānaṃ mamotpannaṃ bhavataśca samāgamāt / bhavatā caiva kāruṇyaṃ diṣṭyā brahman ! kṛtaṃ mama
anartho 'pyarthatāṃ yāti puruṣasya śubhodaye / yathedamupakārāya vyasanaṃ saṅgamāttava
subāhurupakārī me sa ca kāśipatiḥ prabho / yayoḥ kṛte 'haṃ saṃprāpto yogīśa ! bhavato 'ntikam
so 'hantava prasādāgni-nirdagdhājñānakilviṣaḥ / tathā yatiṣye yenedṛṅ na bhūyāṃ duḥ khabhājanam
parityajiṣye gārhasthyamārtipādapakānanam / tvatto 'nujñāṃ samāsādya jñānadāturmahātmanaḥ
dattātreya uvāca gaccha rājendra ! bhadraṃ te yathā te kathitaṃ mayā / nirmamo nirahaṅkārastathā cara vimuktaye
jaḍa uvāca evamuktaḥ praṇamyainamājagāma tvarānvitaḥ / yatra kāśipatirbhrātā subāhuścāsya so 'grajaḥ
samutpatya mahābahuṃ so 'larkaḥ kāśibhūpatim / subāhoragrato vīramuvāca prahasanniva
rājyakāmuka kāśīśa ! bhujyatāṃ rājyamūrjitam / tathā ca rocate tadvat subāhoḥ saṃprayaccha vā
kāśirāja uvāca kimalarka ! parityaktaṃ rājyaṃ te saṃyugaṃ vinā / kṣatriyasya na dharmo 'yaṃ bhavāṃśca kṣatradharmavit
nirjitāmātyavargastu tyaktvā maraṇajaṃ bhayam / sandadhīta śaraṃ rājā lakṣyamuddiśya vairiṇam
taṃ jitvā nṛpatirbhogān yathābhilaṣitān varān / bhuñjīta paramaṃ siddhyai yajeta ca mahāmakhaiḥ
alarka uvāca evamīdṛśakaṃ vīra ! mamāpyāsīnmanaḥ purā / sāmprataṃ viparītārthaṃ śṛṇu cāpyatra kāraṇam
yathāyaṃ bhautikaḥ saṅghastathāntaḥ karaṇaṃ nṛṇām / guṇāstu sakalāstadvadaśeṣeṣveva jantuṣu
cicchaktireka evāyaṃ yadā nānyo 'sti kaścana / tadā kā nṛpate jñānānmitrāriprabhubhṛtyatā
tanmayā duḥ khamāsādya tvadbhayodbhavamuttamam / dattātreyaprasādena jñānaṃ prāptaṃ nareśvara
nirjitendriyavargastu tyaktvā saṅgamaśeṣataḥ / mano brahmaṇi sandhāya tajjaye paramo jayaḥ
saṃsādhyamanyattatsiddhyai yataḥ kiñcinna vidyate / indriyāṇi ca saṃyamya tataḥ siddhiṃ niyacchati
so 'haṃ na te 'rirna mamāsi śatruḥ subāhureṣo na mamāpakārī / dṛṣṭaṃ mayā sarvamidaṃ yathātmā anviṣyatāṃ bhūpa ! ripustvayānyaḥ
itthaṃ sa tenābhihito narendro hṛṣṭaḥ samutthāya tataḥ subāhuḥ / diṣṭyeti taṃ bhrātaramābhinandya kāśīśvaraṃ vākyamidaṃ babhāṣe

iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe ariṣṭakathanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ catuścatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ subāhuruvāca yadarthaṃ nṛpaśārdūla ! tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ / tanmayā sakalaṃ prāptaṃ yāsyāmi tvaṃ sukhī bhava
kākhirāja uvāca kiṃ nimittaṃ bhavān prāpto niṣpannor'thaśca kastava / subāho ! tanmamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
samākrāntamalarkeṇa pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mahat / rājyaṃ dehīti nirjitya tvayāhamabhicoditaḥ
tato mayā samākramya rājyamasyānujasya te / etatte balamānītaṃ tadbhuṅkṣvasvakulocitam
subāhuruvāca kāśirāja ! nibodha tvaṃ yadarthamayamudyamaḥ / kṛto mayā bhavāṃścaiva kārito 'tyantamudyamam
bhrātā mamāyaṃ grāmyeṣu sakto bhogeṣu tattvavit / vimūḍhau bodhavantau ca bhrātarāvagrajau mama
tayormama ca yanmātrā bālye stanyaṃ yathā mukhe / tathāvabodho vinyastaḥ karṇayoravanīpate
tayormama ca vijñeyāḥ padārthā ye matā nṛbhiḥ / prākāśyaṃ manaso nītāste mātrā nāsya pārthiva
yathaikamarthe yātānāmekasminnavasīdati / duḥ khaṃ bhavati sādhūnāṃ tatāsmākaṃ mahīpate
gārhasthyamohamāpanne sīdatyasminnareśvara / sambandhinyasya dehasya bibhrati bhrātṛkalpanām
tato mayā viniścitya duḥ khādvairāgyabhāvanā / bhaviṣyatītyasya bhavānityudyogāya saṃśritaḥ
tadasya duḥ khādvairāgyaṃ saṃbodhādavanīpate / samudbhūtaṃ kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhadraṃ te 'stu vrajāmyaham
uṣṭvā madālasāgarbhe pītvā satsāstathā stanam / nānyanārīsutairyātaṃ vartma yātviti pārthiva
vicārya tanmayā sarvaṃ yuṣmatsaṃśrayapūrvakam / kṛtaṃ taccāpi niṣpannaṃ prayāsye siddhaye punaḥ
upekṣyate sīdamānaḥ svajano bāndhavaḥ suhṛt / yairnarendra ! na tān manye sendriyā vikalā hi te
suhṛdi svajane bandhau samarthe yo 'vasīdati / dharmārthakāmamokṣebhyo vācyāste tatra na tvasau
etat tvatsaṅgamād bhūpa ! mayā kāryaṃ mahat kṛtam / svasti te 'stu gamiṣyāmi jñānabhāgbhava sattama
kāśirāja uvāca upakārastvayā sādhoralarkasya kṛto mahān / mamopakārāya kathaṃ na karoṣi svamānasam
phaladāyī satāṃ sadibhaḥ saṅgamo nāphalo yataḥ / tasmāttavatsaṃśrayādyuktā mayā prāptā samunnatiḥ
subāhuruvāca dharmārthakāmamokṣākhyaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam / tatra dharmārthakāmāste sakalā hīyate 'paraḥ
tatte saṃkṣepato vakṣye tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu / śrutvā ca samyagālocya yatethāḥ śreyase nṛpa
mametipratyayo bhūpa ! na kāryo 'hamiti tvayā / samyagālocya dharmo hi dharmābhāve nirāśrayaḥ
kasyāhamiti saṃjñeyamityālocya tvayātmanā / bāhyantargatamālocyamālocyāpararātriṣu
avyaktādiviśeṣantamavikāramacetanam / vyaktāvyaktaṃ tvayā jñeyaṃ jñātā kaścāhamityuta
etasminneva vijñāne vijñātamakhilaṃ tvayā / anātmanyātmavijñānamakhe khamiti mūḍhatā
so 'haṃ sarvagato bhūpa ! lokasaṃvyavahārataḥ / mayedamucyate sarvaṃ tvayā pṛṣṭo vrajāmyaham
evamuktvā yayau dhīmān ! subāhuḥ kāśibhūmipam / kāśirājo 'pi saṃpūjya so 'larkaṃ svapuraṃ yayau
alarko 'pi sutaṃ jyeṣṭhamabhiṣicya narādhipam / vanaṃ jagāma santyaktasarvasaṅgaḥ svasiddhaye
tataḥ kālena mahātā nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ / prāpya yogardhimatulāṃ paraṃ nirvāṇamāptavān
paśyan jagadidaṃ sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam / pāśairguṇamayairbaddhaṃ badhyamānañca nityaśaḥ
putrādibhrātṛputrādi-svapārakyādibhāvitaiḥ / ākṛṣyamāṇaṃ karaṇairduḥkhārtaṃ bhinnadarśanam
ajñānapaṅkagarbhasthamanuddhāraṃ mahāmatiḥ / ātmānañca samuttīrṇaṃ gāthāmetāmagāyata
aho kaṣṭaṃ yadasmābhaiḥ pūrvaṃ rājyamanuṣṭhitam / iti paścānmayā jñātaṃ yogānnāsti paraṃ sukham
jaḍa uvāca tātainaṃ tvaṃ samātiṣṭha muktaye yogamuttamam / prāpsyase yena tad brahma yatra gatvā na śocasi
tato 'hamapi yāsyāmi kiṃ yajñaiḥ kiṃ japena me / kṛtakṛtyasya karaṇaṃ brahmabhāvāya kalpate
tvatto 'nujñāmavāpyāhaṃ nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ / prayatiṣye tathā muktau yathā yāsyāmi nirvṛtim
pakṣiṇa ūcuḥ evamuktvā sa pitaraṃ prāpyānujñāṃ tataśca saḥ / brahman ! jagāma medhāvī parityaktaparigrahaḥ
so 'pi tasya pitā tadvat krameṇa sumahāmatiḥ / vānaprasthaṃ samāsthāya caturthāśramamabhyagāt
tatrātmajaṃ samāsādya hitvā bandhaṃ guṇādikam / prāpa siddhiṃ parāṃ prājñastatkālopāttasaṃmatiḥ
etatte kathitaṃ brahman ! yatpṛṣṭā bhavatā vayam / suvistaraṃ yathāvacca kimanyacchrotumicchasi

iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe pitāputrasaṃvāde jaḍopākhyānaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ pañcacatvāriṃbho 'dhyāyaḥ jaiminiruvāca samyagetanmamākhyātaṃ bhavadibhardvijasattamāḥ / pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca dvividhaṃ karma vaidikam
aho pitṛprasādena bhavatāṃ jñānamīdṛśam / yena tiryaktvamapyetat prāpya mohastiraskṛtaḥ
dhanyā bhavantaḥ saṃsiddhyai prāgavasthāsthitaṃ yataḥ / bhavatāṃ viṣayodbhūtairna mohaiścālyate manaḥ
diṣṭyā bhagavatā tena mārkaṇḍeyena dhīmatā / bhavanto vai samākhyātāḥ sarvasandehahṛttamāḥ
saṃsāre 'smin manuṣyāṇāṃ bhramatāmatisaṅkaṭe / bhavadvidhaiḥ samaṃ saṅgo jāyate nātapasvinām
yadyahaṃ saṅgamāsādya bhavadibharjñānadṛṣṭibhiḥ / na syāṃ kṛtārthastannūnaṃ na me 'nyatra kṛtārthatā
pravṛte ca nivṛtte ca bhavatāṃ jñānakarmaṇi / matimastamalāṃ manye yathā nānyasya kasyacit
yadi tvanugrahavatī mayī buddhirdvijottamāḥ / bhavatāṃ tatsamākhyātumarhatedamaśeṣataḥ
kathametatsamudbhūtaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam / kathañca pralayaṅkāle punaryāsyati sattamāḥ
kathañca vaṃśāḥ devarṣi-pitṛbhūtādisambhavāḥ / manvantarāṇi ca kathaṃ vaṃśānucaritañca yat
yāvatyaḥ sṛṣṭayaścaiva yāvantaḥ pralayāstathā / yathā kalpavibhāgaśca yā ca manvantarasthitiḥ
yathā ca kṣitisaṃsthānaṃ yat pramāṇañca vai bhuvaḥ / yathāsthiti samudrādri-nimnagāḥ kānanāni ca
bhūrlokādisvarlokānāṃ gaṇaḥ pātālasaṃśrayaḥ / gatistathārkasomādi-graharkṣajyotiṣāmapi
śrotumicchāmyahaṃ sarvametadāhūtasaṃplavam / upasaṃhṛte ca yaccheṣaṃ jagatyasmin bhaviṣyati
pakṣiṇa ūcuḥ praśnabhāro 'yamatulo yastvayā munisattama / pṛṣṭastaṃ te pravakṣyāmastat śṛṇuṣveha jaimine
mārkaṇḍeyena kathitaṃ purā krauṣṭukaye yathā / dvijaputrāya śāntāya vratastrātāya dhīmate
mārkaṇḍeyaṃ mahātmānamupāsīnaṃ dvijottamaiḥ / krauṣṭukiḥ paripapraccha yadetat pṛṣṭavān prabho
tasya cākathayat prītyā yanmunirbhṛgunandanaḥ / tatte prakathayiṣyāmaḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ dvijasattama
praṇipatya jagannāthaṃ padmayoniṃ pitāmaham / jagadyoniṃ sthitaṃ sṛṣṭau sthitau viṣṇusvarūpiṇam / pralaye cāntakartāraṃ raudraṃ rudrasvarūpiṇam
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca utpannamātrasya purā brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ / purāṇametadvedāśca mukhebhyo 'nuviniḥ sṛtāḥ
purāṇasaṃhitāścakrurbahulāḥ paramarṣayaḥ / vedānāṃ pravibhāgaśca kṛtastaistu sahasraśaḥ
dharmajñānañca vairāgyamaiśvaryañca mahātmanaḥ / tasyopadeśena vinā na hi siddhaṃ catuṣṭayam
vedān saptarṣayastasmājjagṛhustasya mānasāḥ / purāṇaṃ jagṛhuścādyā munayastasya mānasāḥ
bhṛgoḥ sakāśāccyavanastenoktañca dvijanmanām / ṛṣibhiścāpi dakṣāya proktametanmahātmabhiḥ
dakṣeṇa cāpi kathitamidamāsīttadā mama / tattubhyaṃ kathayāmyadya kalikalmaṣanāśanam
sarvametanmahābhaga ! śrūyatāṃ me samādhinā / yathāśrutaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ dakṣasya gadato mune
praṇipatya jagadyonimajamavyayamāśrayam / carācarasya jagatodhātāraṃ paramaṃ padam
brahmāṇamādipuruṣamutpatti-sthiti-saṃyame / yatkāraṇamanaupamyaṃ yatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
tasmai hiraṇyagarbhāya lokatantrāya dhīmate / praṇamya samyagvakṣyāmi bhūtavargamanuttamam
mahadādyaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ savairupyaṃ salakṣaṇam / pramāṇaiḥ pañcabhirgamyaṃ strotobhiḥ ṣaḍbhiranvitam
puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ nityamanityamiva ca sthitam / tacchrūyatāṃ mahābhāga ! parameṇa samādhinā
pradhānaṃ kāraṇaṃ yattadavyaktākhyaṃ maharṣayaḥ / yadāhuḥ prakṛtiṃ sūkṣmāṃ nityāṃ sadasadātmikām
dhruvamakṣayyamajaramameyaṃ nānyasaṃśrayam / gandharūparasairhenaṃ śabdasparśavivarjitam
anādyantaṃ jagadyoni triguṇaprabhavāpyayam / asāmpratamavijñeyaṃ brahmāgre samavartata
pralayasyānu tenedaṃ vyāptamāsīdaśeṣataḥ / guṇasāmyāttatastasmāt kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitānmune
guṇabhāvāt sṛjyamānāt sargakāle tataḥ punaḥ / pradhānaṃ tattvamudbhūtaṃ mahāntaṃ tat samāvṛṇot
yathā bījaṃ tvacā tadvadavyaktenāvṛto mahān / sāttviko rājasaścaiva tāmasaśca tridhoditaḥ
tatastasmādahaṅkārastrividho vai vyajāyata / vaikārikastaijasaśca bhūtādiśca satāmasaḥ
mahatā cāvṛtaḥ so 'pi yathāvyaraktena vai mahān / bhūtādistu vikurvāṇaḥ śabdatanmātrakantataḥ
sasarja śabdatanmātrādākāśaṃ śabdalakṣaṇam / ākāśaṃ śabdamātrantu bhūtādiścāvṛṇottataḥ
sparśatanmātrameveha jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / balavān jāyate vāyustasya sparśaguṇo mataḥ
vāyuścāpi vikurvāṇo rupamātraṃ sasarja ha / jyotirutpadyate vāyostadrūpaguṇamucyate
sparśamātrastu vai vāyūrūpamātraṃ samāvṛṇot / jyotiścāpi vikurvāṇaṃ rasamātraṃ sasarja ha
sambhavanti tato hyāpaścāsan vai tā rasātmikāḥ / rasamātrantu tāhyāpo rūpamātraṃ samāvṛṇot
āpaścāpi vikurvatyo gandhamātraṃ sasarjire / saṅghāto jāyate tasmāttasya gandho guṇo mataḥ
tasmiṃstasmiṃstu tanmātraṃ tena tanmātratā smṛtā / aviśeṣavācakatvādaviśeṣāstataśca te
na śāntā nāpi ghorāste na mūḍhāścāviśeṣataḥ / bhūtatanmātrasargo 'yamahaṅkārāttu tāmasāt
vaikārikādahaṅkārāt sattvodriktāttu sāttvikāt / vaikārikaḥ sa sargastu yugapat sampravartate
buddhīndriyāṇi pañcaiva pañca karmendriyāṇi ca / taijasānīndriyāṇyāhurdevā vaikārikā daśa
ekādaśaṃ manastatra devā vaikārikāḥ smṛtāḥ / śrotaṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā caiva pañcamī
śabdādīnāmavāptyarthaṃ buddhiyuktāni vakṣyate / pādau pāyurupasthaśca hastau vāk pañcamī bhavet
gatirvisargo hyānandaḥ śilpaṃ vākyañca karma tat / ākāśaṃ śabdamātrantu sparśamātraṃ samāviśat
dviguṇo jāyate vāyustasya sparśo guṇo mataḥ / rūpantathaivāviśataḥ śabdasparśaguṇāvubhau
dviguṇastu tataścāgniḥ sa śabdasparśarūpavān / śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpañca rasamātraṃ samāviśat
